We evaluate SWE-agent on SWE-bench and HumanEvalFix, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both with a pass@1 rate of 12.5% and 87.7%, respectively, far exceeding the previous state-of-the-art achieved with non-interactive LMs. Finally, we provide insight on how the design of the ACI can impact agents' behavior and performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型（LM）智能体正日益被用于自动化数字环境中的复杂任务。正如人类受益于集成开发环境等强大的软件应用程序来完成软件工程等复杂任务一样，我们认为语言模型智能体代表了一类具有自身需求和能力的新型终端用户，它们也将受益于专为其所用软件设计的定制化界面。我们研究了界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体的表现。作为此次探索的成果，我们推出了 SWE-agent：一个助力语言模型智能体自主使用计算机解决软件工程任务的系统。SWE-agent 的定制化智能体-计算机界面（ACI）显著增强了智能体创建和编辑代码文件、浏览整个代码库以及执行测试和其他程序的能力。我们在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上对 SWE-agent 进行了评估，两者均达到了最先进的性能，pass@1 率分别为 12.5% 和 87.7%，远超此前非交互式语言模型所取得的最先进水平。最后，我们深入探讨了 ACI 的设计如何影响智能体的行为和性能。

SpXX1QVKqTs.video_title: Looped Transformers Explained: More Depth Without More Parameters

papers.abstract: We study a novel language model architecture that is capable of scaling test-time computation by implicitly reasoning in latent space. Our model works by iterating a recurrent block, thereby unrolling to arbitrary depth at test-time. This stands in contrast to mainstream reasoning models that scale up compute by producing more tokens. Unlike approaches based on chain-of-thought, our approach does not require any specialized training data, can work with small context windows, and can capture types of reasoning that are not easily represented in words. We scale a proof-of-concept model to 3.5 billion parameters and 800 billion tokens. We show that the resulting model can improve its performance on reasoning benchmarks, sometimes dramatically, up to a computation load equivalent to 50 billion parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种新型语言模型架构，该架构能够通过在潜在空间中进行隐式推理来扩展测试时计算。我们的模型通过迭代一个循环模块来工作，从而在测试时展开至任意深度。这与通过生成更多 Token 来扩展计算的主流推理模型形成了鲜明对比。与基于思维链的方法不同，我们的方法不需要任何专门的训练数据，可以在较小的上下文窗口下工作，并且能够捕捉到难以用语言表达的推理类型。我们将一个概念验证模型扩展到了 35 亿参数和 8000 亿 Token。我们展示了由此产生的模型可以在推理基准测试中提升其性能，有时提升幅度显著，最高可达到相当于 500 亿参数的计算负载水平。

papers.abstract: Large language models have shown remarkable reasoning abilities and scaling laws suggest that large parameter count, especially along the depth axis, is the primary driver. In this work, we make a stronger claim -- many reasoning problems require a large depth but not necessarily many parameters. This unlocks a novel application of looped models for reasoning. Firstly, we show that for many synthetic reasoning problems like addition, $p$-hop induction, and math problems, a $k$-layer transformer looped $L$ times nearly matches the performance of a $kL$-layer non-looped model, and is significantly better than a $k$-layer model. This is further corroborated by theoretical results showing that many such reasoning problems can be solved via iterative algorithms, and thus, can be solved effectively using looped models with nearly optimal depth. Perhaps surprisingly, these benefits also translate to practical settings of language modeling -- on many downstream reasoning tasks, a language model with $k$-layers looped $L$ times can be competitive to, if not better than, a $kL$-layer language model. In fact, our empirical analysis reveals an intriguing phenomenon: looped and non-looped models exhibit scaling behavior that depends on their effective depth, akin to the inference-time scaling of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. We further elucidate the connection to CoT reasoning by proving that looped models implicitly generate latent thoughts and can simulate $T$ steps of CoT with $T$ loops. Inspired by these findings, we also present an interesting dichotomy between reasoning and memorization, and design a looping-based regularization that is effective on both fronts.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型展现出了卓越的推理能力，而缩放定律（scaling laws）表明，大的参数量（尤其是深度方向上的参数）是其主要驱动力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个更强有力的主张——许多推理问题需要较大的深度，但不一定需要大量的参数。这开启了循环模型（looped models）在推理领域的一种新颖应用。首先，我们证明了对于许多合成推理问题（如加法、p-跳归纳和数学问题），一个循环 L 次的 k 层 Transformer 模型在性能上几乎可以媲美 kL 层的非循环模型，且显著优于 k 层模型。这一结论得到了理论结果的进一步印证：许多此类推理问题可以通过迭代算法求解，因此可以使用具有近乎最优深度的循环模型进行有效解决。令人惊讶的是，这些优势也转化到了语言建模的实际场景中——在许多下游推理任务上，一个循环 L 次的 k 层语言模型即使不优于，也能与 kL 层的语言模型相媲美。事实上，我们的实证分析揭示了一个有趣的现象：循环模型和非循环模型的缩放行为均取决于它们的有效深度，这类似于思维链（CoT）推理的推理时缩放（inference-time scaling）。我们进一步阐明了其与 CoT 推理的联系，证明了循环模型可以隐式生成潜在思维，并能通过 T 次循环模拟 T 步的 CoT 推理。受这些发现的启发，我们还提出了推理与记忆之间的一种有趣的二分法，并设计了一种在两个方面都有效的基于循环的正则化方法。

papers.abstract: Modern LLMs are trained to "think" primarily via explicit text generation, such as chain-of-thought (CoT), which defers reasoning to post-training and under-leverages pre-training data. We present and open-source Ouro, named after the recursive Ouroboros, a family of pre-trained Looped Language Models (LoopLM) that instead build reasoning into the pre-training phase through (i) iterative computation in latent space, (ii) an entropy-regularized objective for learned depth allocation, and (iii) scaling to 7.7T tokens. Ouro 1.4B and 2.6B models enjoy superior performance that match the results of up to 12B SOTA LLMs across a wide range of benchmarks. Through controlled experiments, we show this advantage stems not from increased knowledge capacity, but from superior knowledge manipulation capabilities. We also show that LoopLM yields reasoning traces more aligned with final outputs than explicit CoT. We hope our results show the potential of LoopLM as a novel scaling direction in the reasoning era. Our model is available here: http://ouro-llm.github.io.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型（LLM）主要通过显式的文本生成（如思维链 CoT）来进行“思考”，这种方法将推理推迟到了训练后阶段，且未能充分利用预训练数据。我们提出并开源了 Ouro（命名源于循环的衔尾蛇 Ouroboros），这是一个预训练循环语言模型（LoopLM）系列。该模型通过以下方式将推理能力内置于预训练阶段：（i）潜在空间中的迭代计算；（ii）用于学习深度分配的熵正则化目标；（iii）扩展至 7.7T token 的训练规模。Ouro 1.4B 和 2.6B 模型表现出色，在广泛的基准测试中达到了与高达 12B 参数的最先进（SOTA）大语言模型相当的结果。通过对照实验，我们证明了这种优势并非源于知识容量的增加，而是源于更卓越的知识处理能力。我们还发现，相比显式的 CoT，LoopLM 产生的推理轨迹与最终输出的一致性更高。我们希望研究结果能展示 LoopLM 作为推理时代一种新型扩展方向的潜力。模型获取地址：http://ouro-llm.github.io。

papers.abstract: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science. Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens with a Looped Transformer that reuses the layer stack to increase capacity without adding parameters. For SFT data and trajectory construction, we expand the diversity of executable environments, task assets, and agentic scaffolds through real-world deployment and large-scale synthesis. Our RL pipeline applies mixed-mode RLHF over Think and Non-Think responses to improve overall model quality and reduce failure cases, length-controlled reasoning RL to balance accuracy and reasoning efficiency, and agentic RL with outcome and process rewards to stabilize long-horizon training. Extensive evaluations show that Nanbeige4.2-3B outperforms larger models, including Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B, across diverse agentic benchmarks while remaining competitive on reasoning and alignment tasks. Performance with OpenClaw further supports its use as a compact local personal assistant.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 Nanbeige4.2-3B，这是一款拥有 30 亿非嵌入参数的紧凑型通用智能体模型。它在代码智能体、办公智能体和复杂工具使用任务中表现出色，同时在数学、编程和科学领域保持了极具竞争力的推理能力。Nanbeige4.2-3B 是在 28T tokens 上从头预训练的，采用了 Looped Transformer 架构，通过复用层堆栈在不增加参数的情况下提升了模型容量。在 SFT 数据和轨迹构建方面，我们通过真实世界部署和大规模合成，扩展了可执行环境、任务资产和智能体脚手架的多样性。我们的 RL 流水线采用了针对“思考（Think）”与“非思考（Non-Think）”响应的混合模式 RLHF 以提升模型整体质量并减少失败案例，使用了长度可控的推理 RL 来平衡准确性与推理效率，并利用包含结果奖励和过程奖励的智能体 RL 来稳定长程训练。广泛的评估表明，Nanbeige4.2-3B 在多项智能体基准测试中优于包括 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Gemma4-12B 在内的更大模型，同时在推理和对齐任务上保持了竞争力。在 OpenClaw 上的表现进一步支持了其作为紧凑型本地个人助手的应用潜力。

papers.abstract: Looped architectures provide an inductive bias toward learning step-by-step procedures for tasks that require compositional reasoning. The number of effective layers reached by looping determines the quality of the solution these models find. Like deep architectures, looped architectures are prone to a signal propagation problem induced by depth as the halting decision is postponed. In this paper, we address this signal propagation issue using pre-norm layers and residual scaling. Building on these architectural modifications, we propose FPRM, a Transformer-based Fixed-Point Reasoning Model that uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting mechanism in a looped architecture. We show that fixed-point halting allows FPRM to adapt its compute to task difficulty. FPRM is effective on common reasoning benchmarks, namely Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking, and ARC-AGI.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环架构为学习需要组合推理任务的逐步过程提供了归纳偏置。通过循环所达到的有效层数决定了这些模型找到的解的质量。与深度架构一样，由于停机决策被推迟，循环架构容易出现由深度引发的信号传播问题。在本文中，我们利用预归一化（pre-norm）层和残差缩放（residual scaling）来解决这一信号传播问题。在此架构改进的基础上，我们提出了FPRM，这是一种基于Transformer的定点推理模型，它在循环架构中使用定点收敛作为端到端的停机机制。我们证明了定点停机机制使FPRM能够根据任务难度调整其计算量。FPRM在常见的推理基准测试（即数独、迷宫、状态跟踪和ARC-AGI）中表现有效。

papers.abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matching the unlooped Baseline on all three budgets. We scale SMELT across four sizes up to 54B non-embedding parameters and fit a separate Chinchilla-style scaling law for each architecture. SMELT's loss drops faster with compute, saving 6.8--18.0\% of training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier. The advantage transfers to downstream benchmarks beyond what validation loss predicts, is largest on Code, and grows with sample length and the number of in-context examples. Mechanistic analysis shows that the second visit reduces the attention sink and redirects mass toward content-relevant tokens, an inductive bias that may underlie the observed performance gains. These results show that looping can improve Transformers even under budget matching, offering a practical recipe that turns depth reuse into measurable gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer通过迭代共享的层块来增加有效深度，但大多数评估是在固定模型大小下进行的，这混淆了架构优势与额外FLOPs的影响。我们研究了混合专家（MoE）Transformer上的循环机制，同时严格匹配每个token的FLOPs、总非嵌入参数量以及KV缓存。通过一系列消融实验，我们得出了名为SMELT（Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice）的方法，该方法将中间一半的层循环两次，同时在上述三个预算维度上与未循环的基准模型保持一致。我们将SMELT扩展至最高54B非嵌入参数的四种规模，并为每种架构拟合了独立的Chinchilla式缩放定律。SMELT的损失随计算量的增加下降得更快，在计算最优边界上节省了6.8%至18.0%的训练FLOPs。这种优势转化为下游基准测试性能的提升，其表现超出了验证集损失的预测，在代码任务上表现最为显著，并随着样本长度和上下文示例数量的增加而增强。机制分析表明，第二次遍历减少了注意力的“汇聚点（attention sink）”，并将权重重新分配给与内容相关的token，这种归纳偏置可能是观察到的性能增益的根本原因。这些结果表明，即使在预算匹配的情况下，循环机制也能改进Transformer，并提供了一种将深度复用转化为可衡量收益的实用方案。

papers.abstract: Looped Transformers have attracted substantial attention as a parameter-efficient approach to increasing computational depth through repeated application of shared Transformer blocks. However, their practical advantages over conventional Transformers remain under debate: each additional loop incurs another Transformer pass and requires caching another set of KV states, causing inference FLOPs and KV-cache memory to grow continuously with loop depth. This overhead becomes particularly severe at large loop counts and long context, preventing the parameter efficiency of Looped Transformers from translating into practical inference efficiency. In this paper, we find that much of the additional computation and storage introduced by looping is redundant. As recurrence proceeds, state changes become increasingly concentrated on a small subset of tokens; attention-output differences are dominated by a sparse and stable subset of key columns; and KV residuals between adjacent loops become progressively more amenable to low-bit quantization. Building on these observations, we introduce FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework that reduces cross-loop redundancy through token-sparse updates, sparse attention, and KV-residual quantization. Across several Looped Transformers models, FlashLoop delivers lossless accuracy while achieving up to 1.64$\times$ end-to-end speedup and up to 6$\times$ KV-cache memory reduction, substantially improving the practicality of scaling Looped Transformers to greater computational depths and longer context.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer（Looped Transformers）作为一种参数高效的方法，通过重复应用共享的Transformer块来增加计算深度，从而引起了广泛关注。然而，它们相对于传统Transformer的实际优势仍存在争议：每次额外的循环都会增加一次Transformer传递，并需要缓存另一组KV状态，导致推理FLOPs和KV缓存内存随循环深度持续增长。这种开销在循环次数较多和上下文较长时尤为严重，阻碍了循环Transformer的参数效率转化为实际的推理效率。在本文中，我们发现循环引入的大部分额外计算和存储都是冗余的。随着循环的进行，状态变化日益集中在少数标记（token）子集上；注意力输出差异由关键列的一个稀疏且稳定的子集主导；且相邻循环之间的KV残差变得越来越易于进行低位量化。基于这些观察，我们引入了FlashLoop，这是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过标记稀疏更新、稀疏注意力和KV残差量化来减少跨循环冗余。在多个循环Transformer模型中，FlashLoop在保持无损精度的同时，实现了高达1.64倍的端到端加速和高达6倍的KV缓存内存压缩，显著提升了将循环Transformer扩展到更大计算深度和更长上下文的实用性。

papers.abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction transformers have scaled to over a billion parameters, following the broader trend of increasing model capacity in computer vision. Yet emerging evidence suggests that contiguous transformer layers often behave like repeated applications of similar operations, and multi-view reconstruction transformers refine their predictions progressively across decoder depth. We posit that model depth partially buys iteration, paid for inefficiently in unique parameters, and instead make that iteration explicit in architecture. Our model, DéjàView, applies a single looped transformer block recurrently to per-view features for K refinement steps. Trained once, it exposes K as an inference-time compute knob, matching or outperforming substantially larger feed-forward baselines across five reconstruction benchmarks spanning indoor, outdoor, object-centric, and driving scenes, while using a fraction of their parameters and comparable or lower compute. Importantly, the same looped block formulation outperforms an otherwise identical variant with independent per-step parameters under matched training data and compute, suggesting that explicit iteration is not merely a compute-efficient substitute for capacity but a stronger inductive bias for multi-view 3D reconstruction.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的前馈式3D重建Transformer模型遵循了计算机视觉中模型容量不断扩大的趋势，参数量已超过十亿。然而，越来越多的证据表明，连续的Transformer层往往表现得像相似操作的重复应用，且多视图重建Transformer在解码器深度上逐步优化其预测结果。我们认为模型深度部分起到了迭代的作用，但却以低效的独立参数作为代价，因此我们转而在架构中显式地实现这种迭代。我们的模型DéjàView将单个循环Transformer块递归地应用于每个视图的特征，进行K次优化步骤。经过一次训练后，它将K作为推理阶段的计算调节旋钮，在涵盖室内、室外、以物体为中心和驾驶场景的五个重建基准测试中，其性能达到了或超过了规模大得多的前馈基线模型，同时仅使用了极小部分的参数和相当甚至更低的计算量。重要的是，在匹配训练数据和计算量的情况下，这种循环块方案优于参数独立的同类变体，这表明显式迭代不仅是容量的高效计算替代方案，更是多视图3D重建中更强的归纳偏置。

papers.abstract: We introduce Elastic Looped Transformers (ELT), a highly parameter-efficient class of visual generative models based on a recurrent transformer architecture. While conventional generative models rely on deep stacks of unique transformer layers, our approach employs iterative, weight-shared transformer blocks to drastically reduce parameter counts while maintaining high synthesis quality. To effectively train these models for image and video generation, we propose the idea of Intra-Loop Self Distillation (ILSD), where student configurations (intermediate loops) are distilled from the teacher configuration (maximum training loops) to ensure consistency across the model's depth in a single training step. Our framework yields a family of elastic models from a single training run, enabling Any-Time inference capability with dynamic trade-offs between computational cost and generation quality, with the same parameter count. ELT significantly shifts the efficiency frontier for visual synthesis. With $4\times$ reduction in parameter count under iso-inference-compute settings, ELT achieves a competitive FID of $2.0$ on class-conditional ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and FVD of $72.8$ on class-conditional UCF-101.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了弹性循环变换器（Elastic Looped Transformers, ELT），这是一类基于循环变换器架构、参数效率极高的视觉生成模型。传统的生成模型依赖于深度堆叠的独立变换器层，而我们的方法采用迭代式的权重共享变换器块，在保持高质量生成效果的同时，大幅度降低了参数量。为了有效地训练这些模型进行图像和视频生成，我们提出了环内自蒸馏（Intra-Loop Self Distillation, ILSD）的概念，即从教师配置（最大训练循环数）中蒸馏学生配置（中间循环数），以确保模型在单一训练步骤中跨深度的输出一致性。我们的框架通过单次训练运行即可产出一系列弹性模型，从而实现“随时推理”（Any-Time inference）能力，允许在计算成本和生成质量之间进行动态权衡，且模型参数量保持不变。ELT显著提升了视觉合成的效率边界。在同等推理计算设置下，ELT将参数量减少了4倍，并在类别条件下的ImageNet 256×256数据集上达到了2.0的竞争性FID分数，以及在类别条件下的UCF-101数据集上达到了72.8的FVD分数。

papers.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) sequentially process data by updating their state with each new data point, and have long been the de facto choice for sequence modeling tasks. However, their inherently sequential computation makes them slow to train. Feed-forward and convolutional architectures have recently been shown to achieve superior results on some sequence modeling tasks such as machine translation, with the added advantage that they concurrently process all inputs in the sequence, leading to easy parallelization and faster training times. Despite these successes, however, popular feed-forward sequence models like the Transformer fail to generalize in many simple tasks that recurrent models handle with ease, e.g. copying strings or even simple logical inference when the string or formula lengths exceed those observed at training time. We propose the Universal Transformer (UT), a parallel-in-time self-attentive recurrent sequence model which can be cast as a generalization of the Transformer model and which addresses these issues. UTs combine the parallelizability and global receptive field of feed-forward sequence models like the Transformer with the recurrent inductive bias of RNNs. We also add a dynamic per-position halting mechanism and find that it improves accuracy on several tasks. In contrast to the standard Transformer, under certain assumptions, UTs can be shown to be Turing-complete. Our experiments show that UTs outperform standard Transformers on a wide range of algorithmic and language understanding tasks, including the challenging LAMBADA language modeling task where UTs achieve a new state of the art, and machine translation where UTs achieve a 0.9 BLEU improvement over Transformers on the WMT14 En-De dataset.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环神经网络（RNN）通过在处理每个新数据点时更新其状态来对数据进行序列处理，长期以来一直是序列建模任务的事实标准。然而，它们固有的顺序计算特性使得训练速度缓慢。最近的研究表明，前馈架构和卷积架构在机器翻译等某些序列建模任务上能取得更优的结果，且具有能够并行处理序列中所有输入这一额外优势，从而易于并行化并缩短训练时间。尽管取得了这些成功，但诸如Transformer这类流行的高性能前馈序列模型，在许多循环模型能轻松处理的简单任务上却难以泛化，例如在字符串或公式长度超过训练时所见长度的情况下进行字符串复制或简单的逻辑推理。我们提出了通用Transformer（Universal Transformer, UT），这是一种时间维度上的并行自注意力循环序列模型，可以被视为Transformer模型的一种泛化形式，并解决了上述问题。UT结合了Transformer等前馈序列模型的可并行性和全局感受野，以及RNN的循环归纳偏置。我们还增加了一种针对每个位置的动态终止机制，并发现它提升了在多个任务上的准确率。与标准Transformer相比，在某些假设条件下，UT可以被证明是图灵完备的。我们的实验表明，UT在广泛的算法和语言理解任务上优于标准Transformer，包括极具挑战性的LAMBADA语言建模任务（UT在此任务上达到了新的最先进水平），以及机器翻译任务（在WMT14 En-De数据集上，UT比Transformer实现了0.9个BLEU值的提升）。

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expensive to deploy. Parameter sharing offers a possible path towards reducing their size and cost, but its effectiveness in modern LLMs remains fairly limited. In this work, we revisit "layer tying" as form of parameter sharing in Transformers, and introduce novel methods for converting existing LLMs into smaller "Recursive Transformers" that share parameters across layers, with minimal loss of performance. Here, our Recursive Transformers are efficiently initialized from standard pretrained Transformers, but only use a single block of unique layers that is then repeated multiple times in a loop. We further improve performance by introducing Relaxed Recursive Transformers that add flexibility to the layer tying constraint via depth-wise low-rank adaptation (LoRA) modules, yet still preserve the compactness of the overall model. We show that our recursive models (e.g., recursive Gemma 1B) outperform both similar-sized vanilla pretrained models (such as TinyLlama 1.1B and Pythia 1B) and knowledge distillation baselines -- and can even recover most of the performance of the original "full-size" model (e.g., Gemma 2B with no shared parameters). Finally, we propose Continuous Depth-wise Batching, a promising new inference paradigm enabled by the Recursive Transformer when paired with early exiting. In a theoretical analysis, we show that this has the potential to lead to significant (2-3x) gains in inference throughput.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的部署成本高昂。参数共享为减小模型规模和降低成本提供了一条可能的路径，但其在现代 LLM 中的有效性仍然相当有限。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了 Transformer 中的“层绑定”（layer tying）作为一种参数共享形式，并引入了多种新颖方法，将现有的 LLM 转换为较小的“递归 Transformer”（Recursive Transformers）。这些模型在层间共享参数，且性能损失极小。我们的递归 Transformer 可以从标准的预训练 Transformer 高效初始化，仅使用一组独特的层，并在循环中多次重复。我们通过引入“松弛递归 Transformer”（Relaxed Recursive Transformers）进一步提升了性能，通过深度方向的低秩自适应（LoRA）模块增加了层绑定约束的灵活性，同时保持了整体模型的紧凑性。研究表明，我们的递归模型（例如递归版 Gemma 1B）的表现优于同等规模的普通预训练模型（如 TinyLlama 1.1B 和 Pythia 1B）以及知识蒸馏基准模型，甚至可以恢复原始“全尺寸”模型（例如未共享参数的 Gemma 2B）的大部分性能。最后，我们提出了一种“连续深度批处理”（Continuous Depth-wise Batching），这是一种由递归 Transformer 结合早期退出（early exiting）机制所启用的全新推理范式。理论分析表明，该方法有望实现推理吞吐量 2-3 倍的显著提升。

papers.abstract: Scaling language models unlocks impressive capabilities, but the accompanying computational and memory demands make both training and deployment expensive. Existing efficiency efforts typically target either parameter sharing or adaptive computation, leaving open the question of how to attain both simultaneously. We introduce Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR), a unified framework that combines the two axes of efficiency inside a single Recursive Transformer. MoR reuses a shared stack of layers across recursion steps to achieve parameter efficiency, while lightweight routers enable adaptive token-level thinking by dynamically assigning different recursion depths to individual tokens. This allows MoR to focus quadratic attention computation only among tokens still active at a given recursion depth, further improving memory access efficiency by selectively caching only their key-value pairs. Beyond these core mechanisms, we also propose a KV sharing variant that reuses KV pairs from the first recursion, specifically designed to further decrease memory footprint. Across model scales ranging from 135M to 1.7B parameters, MoR forms a new Pareto frontier: at equal training FLOPs and smaller model sizes, it significantly lowers validation perplexity and improves few-shot accuracy, while delivering higher throughput compared with vanilla and existing recursive baselines. These gains demonstrate that MoR is an effective path towards large-model quality without incurring large-model cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩展语言模型能够解锁令人印象深刻的能力，但随之而来的计算和内存需求使得训练和部署都变得昂贵。现有的效率提升方法通常针对参数共享或自适应计算，这留下了一个问题：如何同时实现这两者。我们引入了 Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR)，这是一个在单一递归 Transformer 中结合了这两个效率维度的统一框架。MoR 在递归步骤中复用了共享的层堆栈以实现参数效率，同时轻量级路由器通过为单个 token 动态分配不同的递归深度，实现了自适应的 token 级思考。这使得 MoR 能够仅在给定递归深度下仍处于活跃状态的 token 之间集中进行二次注意力计算，并通过仅选择性地缓存其键值对（key-value pairs）来进一步提高内存访问效率。除了这些核心机制外，我们还提出了一种 KV 共享变体，它复用了第一次递归产生的 KV 对，专门旨在进一步减小内存占用。在从 135M 到 1.7B 参数的模型规模上，MoR 形成了一个新的帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier）：在相同的训练 FLOPs 和更小的模型尺寸下，它显著降低了验证困惑度（perplexity）并提高了少样本准确率，同时与原生和现有的递归基准模型相比提供了更高的吞吐量。这些增益表明，MoR 是实现大模型质量而无需承担大模型成本的有效路径。

papers.abstract: Increasing model size when pretraining natural language representations often results in improved performance on downstream tasks. However, at some point further model increases become harder due to GPU/TPU memory limitations and longer training times. To address these problems, we present two parameter-reduction techniques to lower memory consumption and increase the training speed of BERT. Comprehensive empirical evidence shows that our proposed methods lead to models that scale much better compared to the original BERT. We also use a self-supervised loss that focuses on modeling inter-sentence coherence, and show it consistently helps downstream tasks with multi-sentence inputs. As a result, our best model establishes new state-of-the-art results on the GLUE, RACE, and \squad benchmarks while having fewer parameters compared to BERT-large. The code and the pretrained models are available at https://github.com/google-research/ALBERT.
papers.abstract_zh: 在预训练自然语言表示时，增加模型规模通常能提升下游任务的性能。然而，受限于 GPU/TPU 的显存容量和更长的训练时间，模型规模的进一步扩大变得愈发困难。为解决这些问题，我们提出了两种参数缩减技术，旨在降低显存消耗并提升 BERT 的训练速度。详尽的实证结果表明，与原始 BERT 相比，我们提出的方法使模型具有更好的可扩展性。我们还使用了一种侧重于建模句间连贯性的自监督损失函数，并证明其始终能对涉及多句输入的下游任务产生积极影响。最终，我们的最佳模型在 GLUE、RACE 和 SQuAD 基准测试上刷新了最优结果，且参数量较 BERT-large 更少。代码和预训练模型已发布于 https://github.com/google-research/ALBERT。

papers.abstract: Transformer-based language models spread FLOPs uniformly across input sequences. In this work we demonstrate that transformers can instead learn to dynamically allocate FLOPs (or compute) to specific positions in a sequence, optimising the allocation along the sequence for different layers across the model depth. Our method enforces a total compute budget by capping the number of tokens ($k$) that can participate in the self-attention and MLP computations at a given layer. The tokens to be processed are determined by the network using a top-$k$ routing mechanism. Since $k$ is defined a priori, this simple procedure uses a static computation graph with known tensor sizes, unlike other conditional computation techniques. Nevertheless, since the identities of the $k$ tokens are fluid, this method can expend FLOPs non-uniformly across the time and model depth dimensions. Thus, compute expenditure is entirely predictable in sum total, but dynamic and context-sensitive at the token-level. Not only do models trained in this way learn to dynamically allocate compute, they do so efficiently. These models match baseline performance for equivalent FLOPS and wall-clock times to train, but require a fraction of the FLOPs per forward pass, and can be upwards of 50\% faster to step during post-training sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的语言模型通常将FLOPs均匀地分配给输入序列。在本文中，我们证明了Transformer可以学习将FLOPs（计算量）动态分配给序列中的特定位置，并针对模型深度中不同层的序列进行计算分配优化。我们的方法通过限制在给定层中参与自注意力（self-attention）和MLP计算的标记（token）数量（$k$）来强制执行总计算预算。需处理的标记由网络使用top-$k$路由机制决定。由于$k$是预先定义的，这种简单过程使用了具有已知张量大小的静态计算图，这与其他的条件计算技术不同。然而，由于$k$个标记的标识是流动的，该方法可以在时间和模型深度维度上非均匀地消耗FLOPs。因此，计算开销在总量上是完全可预测的，但在标记级别上却是动态且对上下文敏感的。以这种方式训练的模型不仅学会了动态分配计算资源，而且效率极高。在等效的FLOPs和训练挂钟时间下，这些模型能够达到基准性能，但每次前向传递所需的FLOPs仅为原来的一小部分，并且在训练后的采样阶段，步进速度可提升50%以上。

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically constrained to reason in the language space, where they express the reasoning process through a chain-of-thought (CoT) to solve complex problems. However, the language space may not always be optimal for reasoning. Most word tokens primarily ensure textual coherence and are not essential for reasoning, while some critical tokens require complex planning and pose challenges to LLMs. To explore the potential of reasoning beyond language, we introduce a new paradigm called Coconut (Chain of Continuous Thought). Coconut utilizes the last hidden state of the LLM as a representation of the reasoning state, termed "continuous thought." Instead of decoding this state into words, we feed it back to the model as the next input embedding directly in the continuous space. This latent reasoning paradigm enables an advanced reasoning pattern, where continuous thoughts can encode multiple alternative next steps, allowing the model to perform a breadth-first search (BFS) rather than committing prematurely to a single deterministic path as in CoT. Coconut outperforms CoT on logical reasoning tasks that require substantial search during planning and achieves a better trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常被限制在语言空间内进行推理，即通过思维链（CoT）表达推理过程来解决复杂问题。然而，语言空间并不总是推理的最优选择。大多数词元主要用于确保文本连贯性，对推理而言并非必不可少，而一些关键标记则需要复杂的规划，这对LLM构成了挑战。为了探索超越语言的推理潜力，我们引入了一种名为Coconut（连续思维链）的新范式。Coconut利用LLM的最后一个隐藏状态作为推理状态的表征，称为“连续思维”。我们不再将该状态解码为文字，而是将其作为下一个输入嵌入直接反馈给模型，使其处于连续空间中。这种潜在推理范式实现了一种高级推理模式，其中连续思维可以编码多个备选的后续步骤，使模型能够执行广度优先搜索（BFS），而不是像CoT那样过早地局限于单一的确定性路径。在需要大量规划搜索的逻辑推理任务中，Coconut的表现优于CoT，并在准确性和效率之间取得了更好的平衡。

papers.abstract: We present a new approach to modeling sequential data: the deep equilibrium model (DEQ). Motivated by an observation that the hidden layers of many existing deep sequence models converge towards some fixed point, we propose the DEQ approach that directly finds these equilibrium points via root-finding. Such a method is equivalent to running an infinite depth (weight-tied) feedforward network, but has the notable advantage that we can analytically backpropagate through the equilibrium point using implicit differentiation. Using this approach, training and prediction in these networks require only constant memory, regardless of the effective "depth" of the network. We demonstrate how DEQs can be applied to two state-of-the-art deep sequence models: self-attention transformers and trellis networks. On large-scale language modeling tasks, such as the WikiText-103 benchmark, we show that DEQs 1) often improve performance over these state-of-the-art models (for similar parameter counts); 2) have similar computational requirements to existing models; and 3) vastly reduce memory consumption (often the bottleneck for training large sequence models), demonstrating an up-to 88% memory reduction in our experiments. The code is available at https://github.com/locuslab/deq .
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种序列数据建模的新方法：深度平衡模型（DEQ）。受许多现有深度序列模型的隐藏层趋向于某个不动点的观察启发，我们提出了DEQ方法，通过求根直接找到这些平衡点。这种方法等同于运行一个无限深度（权重共享）的前馈网络，但具有一个显著优势，即我们可以利用隐函数微分，通过平衡点进行解析反向传播。使用该方法，这些网络的训练和预测仅需恒定的内存，而与网络的有效“深度”无关。我们展示了如何将DEQ应用于两种最先进的深度序列模型：自注意力Transformer和Trellis网络。在大规模语言建模任务（如WikiText-103基准测试）中，我们证明了DEQ：1）在参数量相近的情况下，通常能提升这些最先进模型的性能；2）具有与现有模型相似的计算需求；3）极大降低了内存消耗（这通常是训练大型序列模型的瓶颈），在我们的实验中内存降低幅度高达88%。代码已在 https://github.com/locuslab/deq 公布。

papers.abstract: This paper introduces Adaptive Computation Time (ACT), an algorithm that allows recurrent neural networks to learn how many computational steps to take between receiving an input and emitting an output. ACT requires minimal changes to the network architecture, is deterministic and differentiable, and does not add any noise to the parameter gradients. Experimental results are provided for four synthetic problems: determining the parity of binary vectors, applying binary logic operations, adding integers, and sorting real numbers. Overall, performance is dramatically improved by the use of ACT, which successfully adapts the number of computational steps to the requirements of the problem. We also present character-level language modelling results on the Hutter prize Wikipedia dataset. In this case ACT does not yield large gains in performance; however it does provide intriguing insight into the structure of the data, with more computation allocated to harder-to-predict transitions, such as spaces between words and ends of sentences. This suggests that ACT or other adaptive computation methods could provide a generic method for inferring segment boundaries in sequence data.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文引入了自适应计算时间（ACT），这是一种允许循环神经网络学习在接收输入和输出之间执行多少计算步骤的算法。ACT 对网络架构的改动极小，具有确定性和可微性，且不会向参数梯度引入任何噪声。本文提供了针对四个合成问题的实验结果：确定二进制向量的奇偶性、应用二进制逻辑运算、整数加法以及实数排序。总体而言，ACT 的使用显著提升了性能，能够根据问题需求成功调整计算步骤的数量。我们还展示了在 Hutter Prize Wikipedia 数据集上的字符级语言建模结果。在此案例中，ACT 并未带来巨大的性能提升，但它为数据结构提供了有趣的见解，即为更难预测的转换分配了更多计算资源，例如单词之间的空格和句子的结尾。这表明 ACT 或其他自适应计算方法可以为推断序列数据中的段边界提供一种通用方法。

R8Ns8QbN5l4.video_title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models (Oct 2026)

papers.title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future prediction with robot control, yet existing systems often vary the video backbone, interaction structure, supervision, and inference procedure simultaneously, making their design choices difficult to compare. We introduce OPENWAM, an open world-action modeling framework built around a common causal robot-video foundation and configurable video-action interaction. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we perform causal robot-video pretraining on over 10,000 hours of video, then integrate an action expert through a shared Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports joint, video-then-action, action-then-video, and decoupled generation. OPENWAM achieves high success rates on four LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks; robot-video training with causal adaptation improves VTA success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%. The same configurable architecture naturally extends to inverse and forward dynamics, allowing us to study how counterfactual transitions improve independently trained dynamics models beyond demonstrations alone. When only the video predictor is adapted to a new task, a frozen local-context inverse dynamics model trained on counterfactual data and demonstrations achieves 84.0% mean success across four held-out LIBERO-90 tasks, compared with 47.0% for a full-context inverse model and 21.5% for a local-context model trained only on demonstrations. For forward dynamics, counterfactual supervision reduces RGB prediction error by 34.5% and raises outcome identification from 21.1% to 71.3% among 16 same-state outcomes. OPENWAM provides a common testbed for comparing WAM interaction designs and for studying dynamics learning from video data beyond successful demonstrations.
papers.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）将未来预测与机器人控制相结合，但现有系统往往同时改变视频主干网络、交互结构、监督方式和推理过程，使得设计选择难以比较。我们引入了OPENWAM，这是一个围绕通用因果机器人-视频基础并具备可配置视频-动作交互的开放式世界-动作建模框架。从Wan2.2-5B开始，我们在超过10,000小时的视频数据上进行了因果机器人-视频预训练，然后通过共享的Mixture-of-Transformers架构集成了一个动作专家，该架构支持联合生成、视频引导动作生成、动作引导视频生成以及解耦生成。OPENWAM在四个LIBERO套件和现实世界的双臂任务中实现了高成功率；结合因果适配的机器人-视频训练将LIBERO-Long上的VTA成功率从68.4%提高到了97.8%。同一可配置架构可以自然地扩展到逆向和正向动力学，使我们能够研究反事实转换如何改善独立训练的动力学模型，从而超越仅基于演示的学习。当仅对视频预测器进行新任务适配时，在一个仅在反事实数据和演示上训练的冻结局部上下文逆向动力学模型中，其在四个未见过的LIBERO-90任务上实现了84.0%的平均成功率，相比之下，全上下文逆向模型为47.0%，而仅在演示上训练的局部上下文模型仅为21.5%。对于正向动力学，反事实监督将RGB预测误差降低了34.5%，并将16个相同状态结果中的结果识别率从21.1%提高到了71.3%。OPENWAM为比较WAM交互设计以及研究超越成功演示的视频数据动力学学习提供了一个通用测试平台。

qYGXySKz9r8.video_title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel (Oct 2026)

papers.title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Dense 3D point tracking has been a prominent paradigm for modeling motion in dynamic scenes, but a point track is just a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel: it captures where pixels go, not the rotation of the underlying part, nor which pixels move together as one body. We propose MoSE3, the first feed-forward model that predicts dense SE(3) motion from monocular RGB video, producing full 6-DoF rigid transforms at every pixel in world space. Per-pixel SE(3) motion offers a richer view of how a scene moves: rotation, translation, and grouping all at once. Directly predicting SE(3) is challenging: rotations lie on a curved manifold that is ill-suited to Euclidean regression, and annotations for SE(3) are particularly difficult to acquire. To address these challenges, MoSE3 predicts per-pixel SE(3) through two jointly learned intermediates, 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings, and recovers SE(3) by differentiably fitting transforms within each soft rigid cluster, enabling end-to-end prediction and supervision. To close the data gap, we introduce Art-Kubric, a large-scale synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels for articulated objects with rich physical interactions. MoSE3 achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on both rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, while showing strong generalization to real-world videos despite being trained solely on synthetic motion data.
papers.abstract_zh: 稠密三维点跟踪一直是建模动态场景运动的重要范式，但点轨迹仅是每个像素的3自由度（3-DoF）平移曲线：它捕捉了像素的去向，却无法捕捉底层部件的旋转，也无法识别哪些像素作为同一刚体协同运动。我们提出了MoSE3，这是首个从单目RGB视频预测稠密SE(3)运动的前馈模型，能够在世界空间中为每个像素生成完整的6自由度（6-DoF）刚体变换。逐像素的SE(3)运动提供了关于场景运动更丰富的视角：同时涵盖了旋转、平移和分组信息。直接预测SE(3)极具挑战性：旋转位于弯曲流形上，不适用于欧几里得回归，且SE(3)的标注获取尤为困难。为了应对这些挑战，MoSE3通过两个联合学习的中间量（三维点轨迹和刚性嵌入）来预测逐像素SE(3)，并通过在每个软刚性簇内可微地拟合变换来恢复SE(3)，从而实现端到端的预测与监督。为了弥补数据缺口，我们引入了Art-Kubric，这是一个包含丰富物理交互的关节物体大规模合成数据集，提供稠密的SE(3)和刚性标签。MoSE3在刚性和关节物体基准测试中，在像素、部件和物体级别上均实现了最先进的SE(3)估计效果，并在三个数据集上达到了最先进的平均三维点跟踪精度，同时在仅使用合成运动数据训练的情况下，展现出了对真实世界视频的强大泛化能力。

yZMQcjAMsnY.video_title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Modern chess engines are silent experts: they play at a superhuman level, but do not offer explanations for their play. On the other hand, language models (LMs) can generate plausible-sounding explanations, but their weak playing strength limits the utility of their explanations. We introduce Queen, a 4B-parameter chess-language model that can explain its moves and plans while playing at the level of a typical Grandmaster. Our novel framework enables domain-specific reasoning through complementary components: an encoder-decoder architecture and an iterative distillation algorithm. This architecture integrates a silent expert chess encoder with an instruction-tuned LM through cross-attention, which we train via a question-answering curriculum to extract chess concepts from the encoder's representations. Building on this domain-adapted model, we iteratively improve its explanations with a natural-language analog of the Bellman update: the model analyzes the positions after its top candidate moves and consolidates them into an explanation of the current position, which is then distilled back into the model. Over seven iterations, our model gains over 900 Elo points (1782 to 2697), substantially surpassing all frontier models on both playing strength and puzzle accuracy, despite containing three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Furthermore, LM-based evaluations show that our explanations are fluent and approach GPT-5.6-Sol (high) in coherence. The generality of our architecture and training procedure suggests a recipe for applying language models to domains where silent expert encoders are available, like games, robotics, and computer use.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代国际象棋引擎是沉默的专家：它们以超人类的水平进行对弈，却无法对其行棋逻辑做出解释。另一方面，语言模型（LMs）能够生成听起来合理的解释，但其较弱的棋力限制了这些解释的效用。我们推出了 Queen，这是一个拥有 40 亿参数的国际象棋语言模型，它能够在达到典型特级大师水平的同时，对其走法和计划进行解释。我们新颖的框架通过互补组件实现了特定领域的推理：即编码器-解码器架构和迭代蒸馏算法。该架构通过交叉注意力机制将沉默的专家级国际象棋编码器与经过指令微调的语言模型集成，我们通过问答课程进行训练，从编码器的表示中提取国际象棋概念。在这一领域适配模型的基础上，我们使用自然语言版的贝尔曼更新（Bellman update）迭代改进其解释：模型分析其候选走法之后的局面，并将分析结果整合为对当前局面的解释，随后将其蒸馏回模型中。经过七次迭代，我们的模型提升了超过 900 Elo 分（从 1782 提升至 2697），在棋力和残局准确率上均大幅超越了所有前沿模型，尽管其参数量少了三个数量级。此外，基于语言模型的评估表明，我们的解释流畅，且连贯性接近 GPT-5.6-Sol（高）。我们的架构和训练流程的通用性，为将语言模型应用于存在沉默专家编码器的领域（如游戏、机器人和计算机操作）提供了一种范式。

papers.title: UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models benefit from the understanding and reasoning capabilities of pretrained vision-language models, but action-only supervision provides limited grounding in world dynamics. Conversely, world-action models inherit spatiotemporal priors from video generation models, yet remain limited in semantic understanding and reasoning under distribution shifts. We introduce UniWAM, a unified architecture that integrates a physical reasoner, a world generator, and an action predictor to jointly learn semantic understanding of the physical world, visual generation, and action prediction. To ensure the quality of the training data, we developed a rigorous data cleaning and annotation pipeline for both human egocentric data and robot data. To adapt the vision-language component to embodied tasks while preserving its inherited language capabilities, we represent low-level actions in natural language and introduce a pre-training recipe that assigns complementary supervision from visual question answering (VQA) data, human egocentric data, and robot demonstrations to the appropriate model components. During post-training, future visual noise augmentation reduces reliance on precise future predictions, while history-conditioned flow matching uses encoded action history to initialize action generation. Together, these designs significantly reduce denoising steps while maintaining performance. UniWAM achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple evaluations, including in-distribution performance, robustness, generalization, instruction following, and long-horizon task execution. Furthermore, we uncover a log-linear scaling law of unified human-robot co-training, demonstrating the effectiveness of large-scale pre-training on a mixture of human and robot data.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型受益于预训练视觉-语言模型的理解和推理能力，但仅基于动作的监督在世界动力学方面的基础较为薄弱。相反，世界-动作模型继承了视频生成模型的时空先验，但在分布偏移下的语义理解和推理能力仍受限。我们提出了 UniWAM，这是一种统一架构，集成了物理推理器、世界生成器和动作预测器，旨在共同学习物理世界的语义理解、视觉生成和动作预测。为了确保训练数据质量，我们为人类第一人称视角数据和机器人数据开发了一套严格的数据清洗与标注流程。为了使视觉-语言组件在适应具身任务的同时保留其固有的语言能力，我们将底层动作表述为自然语言，并引入了一种预训练方案，通过该方案将来自视觉问答（VQA）数据、人类第一人称视角数据和机器人演示的互补性监督分配给相应的模型组件。在后训练阶段，未来视觉噪声增强技术减少了对精确未来预测的依赖，而历史条件流匹配（history-conditioned flow matching）则利用编码后的动作历史来初始化动作生成。这些设计共同显著减少了去噪步骤，同时保持了性能。UniWAM 在多项评估中均达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能，包括分布内性能、鲁棒性、泛化能力、指令遵循以及长程任务执行。此外，我们揭示了人类与机器人统一协同训练的对数线性缩放定律，证明了在人类和机器人混合数据上进行大规模预训练的有效性。

pu_82S-qYfo.video_title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models (Oct 2026)

papers.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.
papers.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型在预测未来状态和现实世界规划方面展现出了卓越的能力。然而在实践中，我们缺乏一种原则性的方法来评估模型性能如何随模型规模、数据量和计算资源进行扩展，这一悬而未决的问题拖慢了该领域的发展。在本项工作中，我们提出了RoboJEPA，这是一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型，并在涵盖12种机器人具身的大规模数据集上进行了训练。我们证明了RoboJEPA的想象误差（即其潜在演化过程的误差）遵循计算资源的二阶幂律，这使我们能够准确预测超出拟合规模范围的模型质量。我们进一步表明，下游机器人规划性能会随着计算资源的增加而可预测地提升，且想象误差与性能之间存在高度相关性，使其成为真实机器人评估的可靠代理指标。最后，我们展示了潜在世界模型可以作为机器人智能体进行零样本部署，通过以单张目标图像为导向进行规划，在真实硬件上解决需要长时程规划的任务。我们发布了所有模型检查点以及训练和机器人部署代码。据我们所知，这是首个为在真实机器人数据上训练的多具身机器人世界模型建立扩展定律的工作；RoboJEPA拥有80亿参数，是迄今为止训练规模最大的JEPA预测模型。

kFdBQnKD014.video_title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients (Oct 2026)

papers.title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations. Website: https://qf3-rl.github.io/
papers.abstract_zh: 流策略（Flow policies）已成为从演示中学习机器人行为的标准策略类，但强化学习对于改进预训练流策略或通过交互从头开始学习它们仍然至关重要。我们引入了 QF3（Filtered Q-Gradients 的快速流强化学习），这是一种在线离线（off-policy）强化学习算法。它通过流匹配（flow matching）结合评论家（critic）的动作梯度来训练流策略，并将梯度通过流输出的一步预测进行反向传播。为了在评论家和该预测可靠的地方进行更新，QF3 仅将评论家梯度应用于保持在回放动作附近的动作维度。据我们所知，QF3 是首个从头开始训练人形机器人运动策略并将其零样本（zero-shot）迁移到硬件上的离线流强化学习方法。结合高吞吐量的离线训练方案，它在训练人形机器人运动和运动跟踪策略时，比近期的一种在线（on-policy）流强化学习方法 FPO++ 的实际运行速度提升了 10 倍。我们进一步将 QF3 应用于在 ABC-Sim 和 Robomimic 任务上微调预训练的基于流的操作策略。这些结果表明，QF3 既能从头开始学习机器人策略，也能优化从演示中获取的策略。网站：https://qf3-rl.github.io/

6ozSoUYqnbY.video_title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas? (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas? (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们从压缩的角度评估了语言模型生成新颖研究想法的能力。我们的目标是为语言模型在没有任何提示的情况下生成未来研究想法本质的极小概率设定下界。我们没有通过昂贵的重复采样来估算这一概率，而是提出了“定价引导”（Priced Guidance）框架来衡量压缩成本，即需要多少额外的信息位来引导模型恢复目标想法。我们证明，如果模型在期望下最多需要 K 位的引导即可恢复目标想法，那么它在没有任何引导的情况下生成该想法的概率至少为 $2^{-K}$。在我们的框架中，语言模型（称为生成器）可以提出一系列多项选择题，并为可能的答案指定概率分布。引导者（一个可以获取目标想法的语言模型）负责选择答案。如果所选答案的先验概率为 p，则生成器需支付 $-\log_2 p$ 位成本。生成器的目标是以最小的累积成本生成一个与目标想法本质相符的想法。该累积成本等于（扣除一个加法常数后）引导者发送的信息位数。利用这一方法，我们评估了五种生成器 LLM（Opus 5、Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 GLM 5.3）在 87 篇近期高质量深度学习论文核心思想上的表现，并使用 LLM 作为裁判，判断生成的想法在核心研究对象和定义机制上是否与目标想法匹配。Fable 5.1 实现了最低的中位数压缩成本，为 69.9 位，远低于 gzip 在无损压缩目标想法摘要时 5,712 位的中位数。Fable 5.1、Opus 5 和 Astra 的统一集成进一步将中位数压缩成本降低至 55.8 位，并将生成概率的下界提高了 18,000 倍。

papers.title: Sphere Encoder 2 (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2.
papers.abstract_zh: Sphere Encoder 是一种通过解码高维潜在球体上的随机点来生成图像的自动编码器。我们发现原始方案存在两个限制，降低了其生成质量。首先，在编码后的潜在空间中，随机点倾向于集中在赤道附近而非极点，但训练过程中的旋转无法触及这一区域，从而留下了限制一步生成能力的空白。其次，在生成训练中使用像素级重建损失，会促使解码器对合理的图像进行平均，导致生成的图像模糊且缺乏高频细节。我们提出了 Sphere Encoder 2 来解决这两个限制，在保持自动编码器速度和简洁性的同时，显著提升了图像生成质量。模型已发布于 https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2。

4digoCMhxn4.video_title: UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents (Oct 2026)

papers.title: UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Tool-using AI agents are increasingly deployed across enterprise software systems, yet widely used benchmarks primarily evaluate nominal task completion, conflating baseline planning competence with operational fault recovery. We introduce UndoBench, a benchmark spanning 36 base workflows and 36 fault scenarios across 8 enterprise domains, decoupling task competence from recovery capability via counterfactual paired trials under identical seeds alongside wire-level effect-history and environment-state oracles. On 12 held-out TEST workflows across two open-weight models, two frameworks, and three recovery paradigms (5,760 executions / 2,880 paired trials) in the frozen lost-acknowledgment study, nominal competence reached 83.54% while conditional recovery success rate (CRSR) fell to 46.72%, with naive retry producing duplicate external effects in 53.33% of trials. Extensions to commercial API models reproduced this competence-recovery separation. Evaluations across complementary execution boundaries show that recovery is phase-dependent: before mutation, methods perform similarly without duplicate effects among capable trials; during partial mutation, naive retry, per-call idempotency, and zero-privilege journaling collapse on the evaluated composite workflows; after commit but before acknowledgment, verification and server-side idempotency substantially improve safety. These findings demonstrate that evaluating nominal completion alone masks critical, phase-dependent recovery vulnerabilities in autonomous agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 工具使用型AI智能体正日益广泛地部署于企业软件系统中，然而目前主流的基准测试主要评估标称任务完成情况，将基础规划能力与操作故障恢复能力混为一谈。我们引入了UndoBench，这是一个涵盖8个企业领域、涉及36个基础工作流和36个故障场景的基准测试。通过在相同随机种子下进行反事实配对试验，并结合线路级效应历史和环境状态预言机，该测试实现了任务能力与恢复能力的解耦。在针对两个开源权重模型、两种框架和三种恢复范式（5,760次执行/2,880次配对试验）进行的冷冻丢失确认研究中，12个留出的TEST工作流的标称能力达到了83.54%，而条件恢复成功率（CRSR）降至46.72%，其中简单重试在53.33%的试验中产生了重复的外部效应。对商业API模型的扩展评估重现了这种能力与恢复的分离。在互补执行边界上的评估表明，恢复具有阶段依赖性：在变更发生前，各方法表现相似，且在具备能力的试验中未产生重复效应；在部分变更期间，简单重试、单次调用幂等性和零权限日志记录在评估的复合工作流上均表现失效；在提交后确认前，验证和服务器端幂等性显著提高了安全性。这些研究结果表明，仅评估标称完成情况掩盖了自主智能体中关键的、阶段依赖性的恢复漏洞。

NujneHGo0ZM.video_title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
papers.abstract_zh:
在本文中，我们研究了训练数据如何在基础模型的响应起始标记与后续的推理行为之间建立关联。首先，我们证明了固定特定的起始标记提示语（cue），能使基础模型在数学和编程任务上的表现与经过强化学习（RL）训练的模型相媲美。例如，“.

Okay”这一提示将 Olmo-3-7B 的 MATH-500 pass@1 准确率从 42% 提升至 78%，而“Alright,”则将 Qwen3-14B 的准确率从 72% 提升至 87%。其次，强化学习增加了这些提示出现的概率，而固定这些提示语可以恢复模型相对于基础模型的大部分性能提升。第三，我们将标记提示的推理效应追溯至训练数据。我们通过因果数据干预，将任意词汇（如“chicken”）转化为有效的推理提示，或消除现有提示的效应。类似的编辑使得提示指令“Think duck duck goose”在激发推理能力方面与“Think step by step”同样有效。我们还发现，由不同提示诱导的隐藏状态表示与训练集中不同的文档类型相关联。最后，我们通过语言模型安全性的案例研究扩展了对标记提示的研究，发现不同的提示会引发截然不同的拒绝与合规行为，而这些行为分别对应于不同类型的训练数据。

BxYy0bz7qTk.video_title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. This enables truncated backpropagation in training; terminal key-value (KV) sharing for decoding with almost no loss in accuracy; a distilled student that prefills up to 1.79x faster; and RL updates that compute gradients from saved rollout states, 2x faster than backpropagating through the replayed trajectory. We therefore improve the two components of training that shape these fixed points: the depth prior and input injection. Fixed-depth training breaks KV sharing, and Huginn's broad depth prior supports sharing but dilutes supervision at the target depth more than sharing requires; we learn the prior from prediction feedback, with an entropy term that keeps it broad. Existing injection schemes let the state's component along the input amplify or cancel the injection; we remove this component with orthogonal injection. From 100M to 1.6B parameters, the learned prior and orthogonal injection lower perplexity at every scale relative to Huginn's prior and existing injection schemes, respectively. At 1.6B, the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环语言模型的每一次递归都会增加训练、解码、预填充和强化学习（RL）的成本。循环状态越接近不动点，通往这些状态的路径就越不重要。这使得训练中可以进行截断反向传播；解码时可以使用几乎没有精度损失的终端键值（KV）共享；蒸馏后的学生模型预填充速度提高了 1.79 倍；以及 RL 更新可以通过保存的上线状态计算梯度，比对回放轨迹进行反向传播快 2 倍。因此，我们改进了塑造这些不动点的两个训练组件：深度先验和输入注入。固定深度训练会破坏 KV 共享，而 Huginn 的宽深度先验虽然支持共享，但在目标深度处的监督效果比共享所需的情况稀释得更多；我们通过预测反馈来学习该先验，并使用熵项来保持其广泛性。现有的注入方案允许状态中沿输入方向的分量放大或抵消注入；我们通过正交注入去除了该分量。从 100M 到 1.6B 参数，学习到的先验和正交注入分别在各个规模上降低了相对于 Huginn 先验和现有注入方案的困惑度。在 1.6B 规模下，使用 3 倍更小 KV 缓存的学习先验，其下游平均性能与使用全量缓存的固定深度训练相当。

f8BOj2PrlYU.video_title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas (Oct 2026)

papers.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Scientific research often begins by synthesizing ideas from a set of related papers to identify gaps and formulate new directions. However, training language models to perform this form of literature-grounded ideation remains challenging, as existing approaches based on prompting or feedback lack structured supervision for how papers should be synthesized. We introduce IdeaAnchor, a paradigm for training LLMs to perform research ideation using structured specifications as privileged signals. Each IdeaAnchor instance encodes how each input paper should be synthesized into a successful idea, including their functional roles, relationships, and target synthesis criteria. We build this paradigm by mining instances from published papers, capturing how real ideas emerge from prior literature. We then train models via demonstration, self-distillation, and reinforcement learning, and further enhance generation with retrieval at inference time. Experiments show consistent improvements in ideation quality. Our analysis reveals a functional decomposition: anchor-based training strengthens creative synthesis, retrieval enhances detail elaboration, and combining both yields the best performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学研究通常始于综合一系列相关论文中的观点，以识别研究空白并制定新的方向。然而，训练语言模型执行这种基于文献的构思仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的基于提示（prompting）或反馈的方法缺乏关于如何综合论文的结构化监督。我们引入了IdeaAnchor，这是一种使用结构化规范作为特权信号来训练大语言模型（LLM）进行研究构思的范式。每个IdeaAnchor实例都编码了每篇输入论文应如何被综合为一个成功的想法，包括它们的功能角色、关系以及目标综合标准。我们通过从已发表的论文中挖掘实例，捕捉真实想法如何从现有文献中涌现，从而构建了该范式。随后，我们通过演示、自蒸馏和强化学习来训练模型，并利用推理时的检索进一步增强生成效果。实验表明，构思质量得到了持续提升。我们的分析揭示了一种功能分解：基于锚点的训练强化了创造性综合，检索增强了细节阐述，而将两者结合则产生了最佳性能。

CB90LIbczH8.video_title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数机器人策略在控制循环中保留了一个模型：VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）将观察结果映射为动作，而诸如 Agent-as-Policy 或 Harness VLA 之类的智能体工具框架（Agent Harness）则在运行时通过查询 VLM（视觉-语言模型）来进行决策。我们提出了一种不同的视角：具身世界是一个“具身图灵机”，其纸带是机器人和环境的状态，规则则是策略。如果这种状态可以被精确表示，那么决策过程就可以完全用代码编写。因此，我们提出了“代码即策略”（Code-Only-as-Policy，简称 COAP）：代码通过摄像机图像和本体感觉测量并跟踪机器人、环境和任务状态，并据此做出每一项决策。同一套代码适用于不同的片段（episode），不同的任务共享一个代码库，而无需在循环中使用 VLM 或 VLA。与 VLA 和智能体工具框架相比，我们分析了 COAP 的三个优势：（i）显式状态：状态可以存储在代码中；（ii）执行：代码使决策过程可控，能够灵活地从故障中恢复，且在线运行速度快、成本低；（iii）可扩展性：新任务可以重用、继承或扩展共享库，因此能力可以在任务间积累。这些优势使得 COAP 成为递归自我改进（RSI）的合适媒介：编码智能体在闭环中开发代码库，且每一次变更都是明确且可控的。在 RoboDojo 的 42 项双臂操作任务上，所得的代码库在测试时无需模型即达到了 70.24% 的成功率。COAP 的上限取决于决策所需状态的表征精度以及代码逻辑的稳健性。因此，我们将 COAP 作为具身任务的一种新范式提出；由于它适用于不同的片段，它也可以作为 VLA 和智能体工具框架的高效数据引擎。

2gWgN1JvkmM.video_title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches (Oct 2026)

papers.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models, but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption. We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly. With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra}{Molt library}.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习极大地提升了大语言模型的能力，但其对内存的高需求仍是更广泛应用的障碍。我们引入了 LoGRA，这是一种强化学习后训练方法，通过在低秩梯度草图中保留有效的学习信号来降低内存消耗。这些紧凑的表示既支持模型更新，也支持高效的策略同步。为了防止过大的更新干扰学习，我们在梯度压缩的基础上辅以预测性 KL 步长控制，在应用每次更新前估算策略变化并相应地调整更新幅度。结合所有技术，LoGRA 在推理任务中将平均训练内存使用率降低了高达 45.7%，且未牺牲性能。它还使得在单个八 GPU 节点上稳定训练 27B 参数模型超过 1,100 步成为可能，而在相同环境下使用稠密 Adam 优化器会导致内存不足，从而使原本受限于内存而无法实现的强化学习训练变得切实可行。代码已在 Molt 库中发布。

FjHn53mfzpw.video_title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）已成为一类重要的通用机器人策略，旨在将视频预测先验迁移到行动学习中。然而，我们发现现有的WAMs在开放式环境中经常产生错误的运动预测，导致行动偏差。我们将这一局限归因于两个因素：（1）基础视频模型并未针对操作任务进行优化；（2）将行动组件简单地整合到视频模型中会显著降低其泛化能力。我们引入了视频预测策略2（VPP2），这是一种在视频预测和行动生成方面均具备强大零样本泛化能力的WAM。首先，我们策划了一个大规模、多样化的操作视频数据集，用于对基础视频大模型进行持续预训练。我们为视频片段标注了详细的描述，并执行了“事件级”视频预训练，以提升模型在开放式操作任务中的泛化能力。其次，我们将视频模型后训练并蒸馏为一个具有固定预测周期的单步视觉规划器。最后，我们通过混合Transformer（MoT）架构引入行动模块，以学习隐式逆动力学模型。实验证明了三个关键结果：（1）在开放式任务的视频预测指令遵循成功率上，VPP2-14B超过Cosmos3-64B 11.0个百分点；（2）在真实世界的零样本ALOHA操作任务中，VPP2的成功率超过了目前最强的基线模型18.5个百分点；（3）在进行特定基准测试的后训练后，VPP2在具有挑战性的LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD和RoboDojo基准测试中，达到了所有评估方法中的最高成功率。

BnZFXQLk9ac.video_title: RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)

papers.title: RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires carrying accepted changes into later improvement cycles, while studying agent-proposed changes also requires substantial research infrastructure. Existing settings often leave agents to rebuild routine infrastructure or restrict exploration to individual components. We introduce RSIGym, an agent-native research environment based on Everything as a Service (EaaS). RSIGym exposes training, inference, rollout, evaluation, and sandbox execution through reusable services, with shared budget and permission controls supporting Data, Harness, and Joint improvement tracks. This design enables agents to investigate individual interventions and jointly optimize data, training settings, and execution harnesses within the same environment. We define RSI-Index as the mean fraction of the remaining performance gap closed across five benchmarks covering software engineering, terminal interaction, mathematics, scientific reasoning, and skill-based tasks. Comparing six frontier research models in independent Joint runs, Opus 5 achieves the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809 under a $500 platform-service budget per benchmark run. Its selected systems improve all five benchmarks, raising SWE-bench Verified from 17.67% to 50.33% and AIME from 31.67% to 97.78%. Additional experiments examine DSH-harness refinement, budget variation, and restricted network access, while recorded trajectories reveal how agents diagnose failures and select candidates. We open-source the full RSIGym codebase and results to support reproducibility and further research.
papers.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进要求将已接受的变更纳入后续改进周期，而研究智能体提出的变更也需要庞大的研究基础设施。现有设置通常让智能体自行重建常规基础设施，或将探索限制在单一组件内。我们引入了 RSIGym，这是一个基于“一切即服务”（Everything as a Service, EaaS）的智能体原生研究环境。RSIGym 通过可重用的服务公开了训练、推理、上线、评估和沙盒执行功能，并借助共享的预算和权限控制，支持数据（Data）、工具（Harness）和联合（Joint）改进轨道。这种设计使得智能体能够在同一环境中研究个体干预，并联合优化数据、训练设置和执行工具。我们定义了 RSI-Index 作为跨越软件工程、终端交互、数学、科学推理和技能任务这五个基准测试所缩小的平均剩余性能差距比例。在独立的联合运行中对六个前沿研究模型进行比较，Opus 5 在每个基准运行 500 美元的平台服务预算下，取得了最高的 RSI-Index，达到 0.4809。其选定的系统改进了全部五个基准测试，将 SWE-bench Verified 的成绩从 17.67% 提升至 50.33%，并将 AIME 的成绩从 31.67% 提升至 97.78%。其他实验考察了 DSH 工具改进、预算变化和受限网络访问的影响，而记录的轨迹揭示了智能体如何诊断故障并选择候选方案。我们开源了完整的 RSIGym 代码库和结果，以支持可复现性和进一步的研究。

EzY4IuevtFU.video_title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时机器人控制需要足够的视觉历史来推断运动和任务进度，但处理这些历史数据可能会延迟动作执行。我们提出了Long-WAM，这是一个在实时控制约束下扩展因果世界-动作模型上下文的模型系统框架。我们的核心发现是：拥有历史记录并不等同于利用好历史记录——当视频基础模型通过自回归（AR）预训练时，更长的历史记录能带来更大的收益。我们首先通过机器人和自我中心视频学习因果预测，且无需动作标签，然后在世界-动作适配过程中保留这种“历史到未来”的结构。在RoboCasa GR-1基准测试中，将上下文从0.0秒增加到19.2秒，任务成功率从63.3%提升至78.7%，而双向预训练的初始化方法则没有表现出显著增益；机器人领域的AR预训练进一步提升了在GR-1和LIBERO-Long上的最高成功率。Long-WAM在LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0和DOMINO上对比其他方法也取得了最优结果。流式观测编码、异步执行和硬件加速技术使得该模型能够在RTX 5090、DGX Spark和Jetson AGX Thor上部署且不丢弃未来预测；在RTX 5090上，每个动作块（包括未来视频的潜在预测）的处理耗时为107.4毫秒。在Unitree G1和YAM上的实时部署支持了动态和长时程操纵任务，包括在动态杯子堆叠任务中达到95%的成功率，而Pi0.5和Fast-WAM在20次试验中均未成功。作为一种具备记忆能力的执行器，Long-WAM还能为复合任务中的高层规划提供有效补充。

j0EiOzOD10Y.video_title: A Self-Pruning Transformer: Extreme KV-Cache Compression with Universal Attention (Oct 2026)

papers.title: A Self-Pruning Transformer: Extreme KV-Cache Compression with Universal Attention (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: The large KV-cache size of modern LLMs creates a barrier to efficient deployment. Recent work has explored replacing attention layers' RoPE positional embeddings with alternative decay-based mechanisms, which can then be used to prune KV-cache during inference. However, these decay functions have limited expressivity, and in practice devolve into sliding-window-like eviction patterns. In this work, we propose a unifying framework for complementary and novel decay mechanisms, capturing complex key statistics and interactions while preserving expressive RoPE embeddings and Softmax attention. The resulting Universal Attention is a highly expressive and end-to-end trainable architecture, whose composite decay mechanism acts as a natural, $\textit{adaptive}$ pruning criterion, removing tokens that contribute least to attention computation. Experimentally, Universal Attention achieves state-of-the-art $10\times$ compression on natural language and synthetic task data, while $\textit{improving}$ downstream performance compared to both state-of-the-art baselines and unpruned oracles. It further demonstrates superior long-context generalization with unprecedented $25\times$ compression at length 16k.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型（LLM）巨大的 KV-cache 规模为高效部署带来了障碍。近期的研究探索了用基于衰减的替代机制来替换注意力层中的 RoPE 位置编码，从而在推理过程中剪枝 KV-cache。然而，这些衰减函数的表达能力有限，在实践中往往退化为类似滑动窗口的驱逐模式。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于互补且新颖的衰减机制的统一框架，它在保留高表达力 RoPE 编码和 Softmax 注意力的同时，捕获了复杂的键（Key）统计信息和交互。由此产生的通用注意力（Universal Attention）架构具有极高的表达能力且支持端到端训练，其复合衰减机制充当了一种自然的“自适应”剪枝准则，能够移除对注意力计算贡献最小的 token。实验表明，通用注意力在自然语言和合成任务数据上实现了 $10	imes$ 的最先进压缩比，同时与最先进的基准模型以及未剪枝的预言机（oracles）相比，下游性能还有所提升。此外，它在 16k 长度下展现了出色的长上下文泛化能力，实现了前所未有的 $25	imes$ 压缩。

AlpYM7TJAWQ.video_title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer (Oct 2026)

papers.title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 仿真技术能够实现大规模、低成本的机器人数据生成，但由于仿真与现实世界之间的视觉差异，在仿真环境中训练的策略往往难以迁移至真实世界。现有方法通常依赖中间表征，但这可能会丢失丰富的语义信息，或需要在部署时引入额外的感知模块。我们提出了 RoboRender 框架来解决这一视觉仿真到现实的鸿沟，该框架将仿真轨迹转换为用于策略学习的逼真 RGB 视频。RoboRender 训练了一个以仿真深度视频、语言指令和机器人 RGB 掩码视频为条件的面向机器人的视频生成模型，在合成逼真纹理、背景和干扰物的同时，保留了模拟器的几何结构、机器人运动和动作标签。生成的 RGB 视频与模拟器提供的状态和动作配对，用于训练零样本真实世界部署的策略。在机器人视频测试集上，我们的视频模型在生成质量方面优于基于深度的视频生成基线。在涵盖抓取与放置、关节物体操控和移动操控任务的真实世界实验中，在 RoboRender 生成数据上训练的策略达到了 71% 的平均成功率，比原始仿真渲染和常规视觉域随机化方法分别高出约 7.1 倍和 3.6 倍。我们进一步证明，随着每条仿真轨迹生成视频数量的增加，策略性能也随之提升，使开启任务的成功率提高了 65 个百分点。这些结果表明，生成式视频渲染有效缓解了零样本策略迁移在视觉上的仿真到现实鸿沟。项目网站：https://robo-render.github.io/。

SKng03lzY_0.video_title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models (Oct 2026)

papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在将交互经验转化为持续的改进，然而外部反馈成本高昂，且随着策略的演进，世界模型预测可能会变得不可靠。我们引入了RSI-Anything，这是一个基于JEPA-Anything构建的领域通用框架，它利用预测性世界模型来指导行动和学习数据的选择。观测到的反馈驱动策略或工作流程的改进以及条件性世界模型自适应，同时通过组件和兼容性检查来管理更新后的策略-模型对的保留。在多种计算和科学领域中，RSI-Anything展现出了显著的增益。在代码修复任务中，保持编码器固定不变，成功率从使用静态验证器的26.3%通过预测性选择提升至29.2%，在进行世界模型自适应后进一步达到31.2%，且测试使用量相当。图形用户界面（GUI）评估显示任务完成率更高，同时平均操作步数减少了39.4%。在五个连续的策略版本中，实验室规划得分从21.80%翻倍以上，达到46.01%。在反应优化方面，在相同的40次实验预算下，RSI-Anything实现的平均最佳观测产率为96.15%，而贝叶斯优化为82.16%。一项端到端的免疫科学应用进一步将工作流程演进和预测建模与治疗假设的生成联系起来。这些结果证明了预测性世界模型和保留的系统更新如何能够在多样化的环境中实现递归改进。

JHWJpYIHzyQ.video_title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing (Oct 2026)

papers.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）路由将推理任务分发到不同的模型中，从而推进了LLM服务在成本与质量之间的帕累托前沿。尽管基于会话或查询层级的粗粒度路由已在生产系统中得到广泛应用，但近期的算法研究表明，细粒度的Token级路由能够带来显著的效率和质量提升。然而，高效地服务于Token级路由推理对现有系统构成了严峻挑战。现有的系统多基于单LLM架构假设，在Token级路由下会遭受严重的步长不同步和频繁的批处理准入延迟，且给开发人员带来了沉重的实现复杂性。为了应对这些挑战，我们设计了TokenRouter，这是一个高效且对开发者友好的Token级路由LLM推理服务系统。TokenRouter遵循“以请求为中心的编程，以模型为中心的执行”原则：开发者从单个请求的角度描述路由逻辑，而运行时为每个LLM启动子服务器并异步分发请求。每个子服务器采用延迟批处理调度器，其最优超参数通过系统的数学吞吐量模型推导得出。在多种路由算法、工作负载和模型组合下，TokenRouter实现的解码吞吐量比现有系统高出2.01-64.15倍，显著提升了Token级LLM路由的服务效率。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter 获取。

OGV_QzgM73M.video_title: More than 83.9% of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are distinct and more than 67.35% are…

papers.title: More than 83.9% of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are distinct and more than 67.35% are simple and on the critical line (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Let N(T) count the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function up to height T with multiplicity, N_d(T) the distinct ones, and N_0^s(T) those that are simple and on the critical line. We prove liminf N_d(T)/N(T) >= 1645064/1960733 = 0.83900...; earlier work proves 0.83699..., and a report we have not verified claims 0.83805.... Hence more than 67.80% are simple. Also liminf N_0^s(T)/N(T) >= 0.67353...; earlier work proves 0.67250..., and reports we have not verified claim 0.673492. Two estimates of Lamzouri are improved: at least 88.93% of the zeros are simple or on the critical line, and the proportions of simple zeros and of zeros on the line average at least 83.67%. By the unconditional form of Montgomery's pair-correlation theorem the energy, a sum of a test function over pairs of zeros, is known asymptotically. A zero of multiplicity d contributes d^2 to it and nearby zeros contribute too, so a lower bound for such pairs leaves less energy for multiple zeros. The proof has three steps. First, for zeros at least a fixed fraction of the mean spacing apart, a large sieve inequality lets their pairs be used in full, with multiplicities. Second, their contribution is bounded below by a computer-assisted inequality for seven or eight consecutive zeros which distinguishes simple and double zeros. Its correction terms telescope, as increments of a storage function. Third, the test function is chosen to make this contribution large, at the cost of more energy. We also prove upper limits for what such inequalities can give with the two main test functions. The lower bounds and these limits are proved in Lean 4, analytic inputs included.
