The proofs use three axioms beyond those of Mathlib, one per inequality. Each records that a search program returned true; Lean's kernel does not check the run itself. This work is an experiment in AI-assisted mathematical research.
papers.abstract_zh: 设 N(T) 为黎曼ζ函数直至高度 T 的非平凡零点（计入重数），N_d(T) 为互不相同的零点数，N_0^s(T) 为位于临界线上且为单零点的个数。我们证明了 liminf N_d(T)/N(T) >= 1645064/1960733 = 0.83900...；早期的研究证明了 0.83699...，而我们未验证的一份报告声称其为 0.83805...。因此，超过 67.80% 的零点是单零点。此外，liminf N_0^s(T)/N(T) >= 0.67353...；早期研究证明为 0.67250...，未经验证的报告声称其为 0.673492。我们改进了 Lamzouri 的两项估计：至少 88.93% 的零点是单零点或位于临界线上，单零点和临界线上的零点比例平均至少为 83.67%。根据蒙哥马利（Montgomery）配对相关定理的无条件形式，能量（即测试函数在零点对上的求和）是渐近已知的。重数为 d 的零点对其贡献 d^2，附近的零点也有贡献，因此对此类零点对的下界估计会为重零点留出更少的能量。证明分为三个步骤。首先，对于间距至少为平均间距固定比例的零点，利用大筛法不等式使其零点对能够被充分利用（计入重数）。其次，它们的贡献通过针对七到八个连续零点的计算机辅助不等式进行下界估计，该不等式可区分单零点和二重零点。其修正项作为存储函数的增量呈现递进关系。第三，通过选择合适的测试函数使该贡献最大化，但这会增加能量消耗。我们还证明了在两种主要测试函数下，此类不等式所能给出的上限。下界和这些限制均在 Lean 4 中完成证明，包含了分析输入。证明使用了 Mathlib 之外的三个公理，每个不等式对应一个。每个公理记录了一个搜索程序返回为真的结果；Lean 的内核本身并不检查该运行过程。这项工作是一次人工智能辅助数学研究的实验。

n47UpOP_B08.video_title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态表征实现了零样本分类和检索，但对独立训练的模型进行对齐通常需要大量配对数据。然而，“柏拉图表征假设”（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）提出，在不同模态上训练的模型可能会自发地趋向于共享的表征几何结构。那么，我们是否还需要配对样本来进行跨模态对齐呢？值得注意的是，我们证明了配对样本对于粗粒度跨模态对齐并非必要。我们简单的 Wasserstein Procrustes 方法通过粗粒度几何初始化，在不接触任何配对的情况下，仅通过估计单一正交映射即可对齐两组不相交的嵌入集。跨数据集、模态和单模态模型的实验表明，我们始终能够对齐独立训练的表征而无需配对，且标准的几何对齐指标能够准确预测这种对齐的可行性。尽管如此，我们依然可以从配对样本中获益。在极少量配对样本的情况下，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，而在增加更多样本时，其表现也与基于配对的方法保持竞争力。最后，我们证明了所产生的对齐结果可以在无需配对样本的情况下实现文本到图像的生成。这些结果表明，独立训练的模型往往共享足够的几何结构，从而能够在几乎没有或完全没有配对数据的情况下建立跨模态对应关系。

AzPPSTWxDbM.video_title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution (Oct 2026)

papers.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人基础模型提供了强大的视觉运动控制能力，但当物体位置或任务指令发生变化时，其性能可能会下降。进一步的改进通常需要对大量的机器人数据进行后期训练，而通过远程操作等方法收集这些数据可能成本高昂。代理框架（Agentic harnesses）可以围绕模型进行适配，但当前的自我进化框架在决定追求哪些代码和技能变更时，对机器人试验的使用效率较低。我们引入了 EmbodiedRSI，这是一种自我进化的代理框架，它能自主决定下一步的探索方向，并将由此产生的物理交互转化为改进的代码和技能。EmbodiedRSI 通过一种快慢双系统架构（Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture）实现了这一点，其中相互竞争的代码和技能假设被保存在一个假设图（Hypothesis Graph）中。信息价值实验选择（Value-of-Information Experiment Selection）机制负责选择能够区分这些假设的物理实验，其结果指导代码-技能的协同进化（Code-Skill Co-Evolution）。慢系统构建分层记忆（Hierarchical Memory），奖励导向记忆学习（Reward-Grounded Memory Learning）则根据记忆对后续快系统改进的价值来选择有效的记忆。在 RoboCasa365 上，EmbodiedRSI 的整体成功率为 77.0%，在 Composite-Unseen 任务上为 71.3%，而最佳基准模型仅为 40.1%。EmbodiedRSI 在 LIBERO-Pro 上也达到了 86.8% 的整体成功率。除了基准性能外，EmbodiedRSI 还实现了向真实世界机器人的零样本迁移，在多个具有挑战性的任务中取得了 71.3% 的整体成功率。

JmESZtxnOoE.video_title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)

papers.title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Environments are the foundation of recursive self-improvement: they provide the problems agents work on and the feedback used to evaluate progress. Yet constructing challenging research environments with reliable evaluation still depends on domain experts, limiting their scale and disciplinary coverage. We introduce RSI-Forge, a multi-agent pipeline that turns published papers into executable environments for self-improvement. Three agents coordinate construction, reproduction, and review to produce tasks with automated evaluators; each paper's method is independently reimplemented to establish a baseline score. We present 210 environments across 18 fields, including 90 reviewed by independent human domain experts. Both experts and agent judges give high ratings to the potential for improving the provided starting solutions and the evaluators' ability to distinguish solution quality, whereas experts are more critical of shortcut resistance, faithfulness to the source paper, and whether a single idea can exhaust a task. To validate their use for repeated improvement, we evaluate four models over 3 successive attempts on 120 environments, with each attempt inheriting prior code and notes while model weights remain fixed. At least one model improves after the first attempt in 84% of environments. Models also outperform the reproduced paper methods in 68 of the 120 environments, demonstrating room for gains beyond these baselines. Transcript analysis identifies work beyond parameter tuning in 95% of these successful attempts. Analysis of the resulting trajectories shows that models scoring lower on these tasks explore less, more often accept gains smaller than the reported standard error, and rely more heavily on tuning to the development set. RSI-Forge provides a scalable approach to constructing research environments for training and evaluating self-improving agents.
papers.abstract_zh: 环境是递归自我提升的基础：它们提供了智能体解决的问题，以及用于评估进展的反馈。然而，构建具有可靠评估能力的挑战性研究环境仍然依赖于领域专家，这限制了其规模和学科覆盖范围。我们推出了 RSI-Forge，这是一个将已发表论文转化为可执行环境以供自我提升的多智能体流水线。三个智能体通过协调构建、复现和审查流程，生成带有自动化评估器的任务；每篇论文的方法都被独立重新实现，以建立基准分数。我们呈现了涵盖 18 个领域的 210 个环境，其中包括 90 个经由独立人类领域专家审查的环境。专家和智能体评审员均对提升现有初始方案的潜力以及评估器区分方案质量的能力给予了高度评价，但专家在抗捷径能力、对原始论文的忠实度以及单一思想是否足以穷尽任务等方面更为严苛。为了验证其在重复改进中的应用，我们在 120 个环境上对四个模型进行了 3 次连续尝试的评估，每次尝试都继承了先前的代码和笔记，而模型权重保持不变。在 84% 的环境中，至少有一个模型在第一次尝试后取得了进步。在 120 个环境中的 68 个里，模型的表现也超过了复现的论文方法，证明了在这些基准之上仍有提升空间。转录分析显示，在 95% 的成功尝试中，工作内容超越了参数调优。对所得轨迹的分析表明，在这些任务中得分较低的模型探索较少，更容易接受小于报告标准误差的增益，并且更依赖于针对开发集的调优。RSI-Forge 为构建用于训练和评估自我提升智能体的研究环境提供了一种可扩展的方法。

ZmXiCFZINTg.video_title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities (Oct 2026)

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 能力评估旨在部署前揭示模型的危险行为，但其可靠性依赖于一种假设，即隐藏的能力是可以被诱导出的。我们通过构建后门攻击证明了在对抗条件下该假设并不成立。这种攻击将加密的神经网络嵌入到宿主模型权重中，仅在接收到秘密触发指令时才会解密并执行。利用数字保险箱技术，在密码学假设下，即使能够完全访问模型权重，这些隐藏的电路在证明上依然难以被诱导出和解释，这扩展了先前将固定字符串隐藏为任意计算的研究工作。我们在 PyTorch 中实现了概念验证构建，并通过微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发词搜索以及潜在对抗训练，在一个小型化学反应预测任务（作为 CBRN 相关能力的代理）上评估了诱导效果。我们的结果证明了模型对这些方法的抵御能力，并结合我们的密码学保证，揭示了基于诱导的能力审计的局限性。我们发布了这些模型以支持防御技术的改进。

rPndeoBvi0Y.video_title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）科学智能体是仅依赖初始任务上下文，还是会根据实验反馈调整决策？我们通过神经算子自适应研究了这一问题，即让大型语言模型（LLM）在有限的实验预算下选择微调配置。在偏微分方程（PDE）家族内和跨家族的迁移任务中，LLM 在几乎所有匹配的对比中都实现了比随机搜索和贝叶斯优化更低的保留测试集 nRMSE。仅凭最终性能无法区分其内部逻辑，因此我们通过受控干预验证了每项归因。在观察任何验证分数之前，LLM 的第一个配置就已经排在相应随机搜索池的顶端，这表明模型具有有效的初始偏差。补充的“冷启动”干预显示，模型选择的基础学习率会随 PDE 描述的变化而变化。一旦获得反馈，在已评估的配置之间重新分配验证分数，在每一个测试案例中都会改变后续的提案，而保持数值不变的重写则不会产生类似的汇总效应。这些干预证实，LLM 的决策级行动会对给定任务和观察到的结果做出响应，表明它结合了任务依赖先验与对实验反馈的敏感性。

nHi9ewdtsmQ.video_title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene (Oct 2026)

papers.title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/
papers.abstract_zh: 通用服务机器人需要能够处理陌生环境中各种人类需求的导航系统，从而结合任务通用性和场景通用性。现有的一些方法通过微调多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来预测导航动作，这使得其行为依赖于导航训练数据的覆盖范围，并可能限制其在新任务和新环境下的泛化能力。我们的核心见解是，让 MLLM 专注于解析需求、理解场景和制定决策，同时保留其通用能力，并将运动执行委托给导航工具。为了实现这一设想，我们推出了 SuperNav，它为预训练的 MLLM 配备了一个专门的智能体支撑框架（agent harness），而无需对 MLLM 进行针对导航的微调。该框架通过导航技能（Navigation Skills）、面向智能体的物理交互工具（Tools）以及任务进度和上下文管理来支持这些决策。统一的视觉点接口将决策与运动连接起来，允许模型直接在图像中指定目的地，并根据执行反馈修改决策。这些组件共同支持在不同任务需求和环境下的持续导航。SuperNav 在实例级、多目标和需求驱动型任务上均优于四个评估基准。在 HM3D 上的类别级评估以及在真实四足机器人上的部署进一步证明了其在不同环境中的适用性。项目页面：https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

PK01lTvxxdk.video_title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control

papers.title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 通用机器人必须执行从敏捷运动到灵巧操作的广泛任务。尽管从仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的强化学习（RL）已被证明是实现这一目标的有效工具，但目前的强化学习流程依赖于繁重的工程化设计，例如针对特定任务的结构化先验，如奖励塑造和演示数据。近期研究表明，多样化的模拟器重置（simulator resets）结合大规模并行仿真，可以在若干操作问题上减轻大部分此类工程负担。然而，我们发现将这种范式简单地扩展到更精确或动态的问题上仍然并非易事。虽然模拟器重置有助于探索，但在该分布上进行均匀采样会浪费越来越多的学习经验，用于策略已经掌握或尚无法尝试的任务配置。这使得在强化学习中通过扩展并行环境获得预期收益变得极具挑战性，因为批处理中的大部分学习信号在训练过程中被浪费了。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了成功引导采样（Success Guided Sampling, SGS），这是一种简单的自适应采样器，旨在将强化学习训练集中在策略能力前沿的任务配置上。这样做使得大规模模拟强化学习能够充分利用批处理中的经验，从而实现更高效的大规模并行仿真扩展。在利用多达 $2^{20}$（超过一百万）个并行环境的实验中，SGS 使强化学习能够解决现有方法无法处理的具有挑战性的多地形四足运动和接触丰富的组装任务。最后，我们将学习到的操作策略蒸馏为基于 RGB 的策略，并展示了在真实硬件上对若干挑战性组装任务的零样本迁移。项目网站：https://sgs-rl.github.io/。

lUjzlmTNRWg.video_title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning? (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning? (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance. Across nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games, training with Jev outperforms a standard RL learner, including where the learner makes no progress alone, while the model itself remains untrained. To our knowledge, we present the first use of Jev within the RL learning process and establish a frozen decision model as a usable component of RL training, inviting further exploration of how Jev and other advanced decision models can improve RL.
papers.abstract_zh: 基础模型为强化学习（RL）提供了先验知识，缓解了其在样本效率和迁移能力方面的长期弱点，但其逐词生成的特性使得查询过程呈现序列化且成本高昂。Jev 是一种近期发布的决策模型，它无需生成过程，即可在单次前向传播中返回经过校准的类型化答案。现有研究将基础模型在强化学习中的应用分为“待训练模型”和“需提示生成器”两类，而 Jev 既不属于这两类，且迄今为止仅在单一领域作为黑盒使用。因此，此类模型在强化学习环境中独立进行决策的能力，以及作为训练组件如何改进强化学习，目前尚未得到解决。为此，本文首先探讨了强化学习系统中的对象对其所消耗答案的要求，并确定了 Jev 除了无法作为价值函数的核心使用外，能够满足所有其他要求。其余对象构成的多个位置各自承担多种角色。随后，我们设计了在其中三个位置部署 Jev 的算法，分别将其作为参考策略、探索判断器和经验回放评估器，以提升样本效率、探索能力和学习性能。在九项 MiniGrid 任务和三项 Atari 游戏中的实验表明，配合 Jev 进行训练的效果优于标准强化学习学习器，即便是在学习器本身无法取得进展的情况下，且模型本身无需训练。据我们所知，我们首次将 Jev 应用于强化学习训练过程，并将冻结的决策模型确立为强化学习训练中的可用组件，旨在促进对 Jev 及其他高级决策模型如何改进强化学习的进一步探索。

Twctm7VGar8.video_title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents (Oct 2026)

papers.title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.
papers.abstract_zh: 交互式虚拟世界允许智能体通过探索和交互进行学习。智能体能学到的内容受限于其所处的练习环境，而环境必须具备忠实性（具有一致的状态、规则和动力学）以及真实性（观察结果符合现实世界的视觉分布）。在多样的世界中同时实现这两点仍然是一个瓶颈。我们引入了 AgentGarten，这是一个将模拟器和游戏引擎与共享神经渲染器耦合在一起，以构建实时交互环境的框架。其模拟后端维护持久的世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则，而渲染器则通过通用接口导出的结构化条件生成视觉观察结果。为了构建该神经渲染器，我们使预训练视频模型适配几何条件，利用我们提出的对抗性强制（Adversarial Forcing）对其进行蒸馏，并优化推理以实现实时交互。对抗性强制通过精确重放使历史预填充（history prefilling）变得可微，从而使后续预测的损失能够更新渲染器编码先前观察的方式，并增加真实数据的对抗性监督以提升其视觉质量。在 AgentGarten 中，智能体通过视觉观察感知世界、实时与之交互，并通过将每一轮经验蒸馏成后续智能体可以继承和优化的“剧本”（playbooks）来不断进步。我们的实证研究表明，学习效率有了显著提升，智能体仅需 4 轮学习，而传统的强化学习对应模型则需要数百万轮。由于新的世界可以编写为代码并通过相同的接口进行渲染，环境可以在数量和难度上与智能体同步扩展，这是朝着通过交互经验不断进化的智能体迈出的一步。

DpXNjo5aYY0.video_title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)

papers.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）是将大型基础模型推向自我提升的核心训练范式。本报告介绍了 MiMo-V2.6 系列，这是一个通过扩展强化学习算力来拓展模型智能边界的全模态家族。在强化学习之前，我们在广泛的多模态语料库上进行了中期训练，以提供充足的探索空间，并在预训练的 hybrid-SWA 架构上构建了坚实的基础设施，以支持后续的扩展。我们从三个维度扩展了强化学习算力：（1）更大的批次和更高的吞吐量，通过异步训练在高达 1M 的上下文长度下，每步消耗 1,568 个样本和 27 亿至 37 亿个 Token；（2）更多样化和复杂的环境，涵盖代码、通用、视觉和网络领域，并结合多种智能体工具；（3）更多的评估器算力，通过组级智能体评分，为长程任务提供更准确的奖励信号，并引导模型生成更短、Token 效率更高的解决方案。为了保持大规模训练的稳定性，我们冻结了 MoE 路由并建立了针对奖励作弊的多层防御机制。我们进一步构建了用于混合任务智能体强化学习的基础设施，包括统一的轨迹表示、高并发多框架部署、解耦的控制与数据平面，以及训练-推理的一致性。我们开源了训练动态、强化学习环境和强化学习框架，以促进对扩展强化学习和模型自我提升的可复现性及进一步研究。

Ot8y0a5mRQY.video_title: Backpropagation Explained: How Neural Networks Learn, and the Attempts to Replace It

papers.abstract: We study empirical scaling laws for language model performance on the cross-entropy loss. The loss scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude. Other architectural details such as network width or depth have minimal effects within a wide range. Simple equations govern the dependence of overfitting on model/dataset size and the dependence of training speed on model size. These relationships allow us to determine the optimal allocation of a fixed compute budget. Larger models are significantly more sample-efficient, such that optimally compute-efficient training involves training very large models on a relatively modest amount of data and stopping significantly before convergence.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了语言模型在交叉熵损失函数上的经验缩放定律。损失与模型大小、数据集大小以及用于训练的计算量呈幂律关系，部分趋势跨越了七个以上的数量级。在较大范围内，网络宽度或深度等其他架构细节的影响微乎其微。简单的方程决定了过拟合对模型/数据集大小的依赖性，以及训练速度对模型大小的依赖性。这些关系使我们能够确定固定计算预算的最佳分配方案。大型模型具有显著更高的样本效率，因此在计算效率最优的情况下，应使用相对适量的数据训练超大模型，并在模型收敛前显著提前停止训练。

papers.abstract: Fine-tuning language models (LMs) has yielded success on diverse downstream tasks, but as LMs grow in size, backpropagation requires a prohibitively large amount of memory. Zeroth-order (ZO) methods can in principle estimate gradients using only two forward passes but are theorized to be catastrophically slow for optimizing large models. In this work, we propose a memory-efficient zerothorder optimizer (MeZO), adapting the classical ZO-SGD method to operate in-place, thereby fine-tuning LMs with the same memory footprint as inference. For example, with a single A100 80GB GPU, MeZO can train a 30-billion parameter model, whereas fine-tuning with backpropagation can train only a 2.7B LM with the same budget. We conduct comprehensive experiments across model types (masked and autoregressive LMs), model scales (up to 66B), and downstream tasks (classification, multiple-choice, and generation). Our results demonstrate that (1) MeZO significantly outperforms in-context learning and linear probing; (2) MeZO achieves comparable performance to fine-tuning with backpropagation across multiple tasks, with up to 12x memory reduction and up to 2x GPU-hour reduction in our implementation; (3) MeZO is compatible with both full-parameter and parameter-efficient tuning techniques such as LoRA and prefix tuning; (4) MeZO can effectively optimize non-differentiable objectives (e.g., maximizing accuracy or F1). We support our empirical findings with theoretical insights, highlighting how adequate pre-training and task prompts enable MeZO to fine-tune huge models, despite classical ZO analyses suggesting otherwise.
papers.abstract_zh: 微调语言模型（LM）在各类下游任务中已取得成功，但随着模型规模的增长，反向传播所需的内存开销变得极其巨大。零阶（ZO）方法原则上仅需两次前向传播即可估计梯度，但理论上对于大规模模型的优化速度极慢。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种内存高效的零阶优化器（MeZO），它通过对经典ZO-SGD方法进行适配以实现原地（in-place）操作，从而使语言模型的微调内存占用与推理阶段相同。例如，在使用单张A100 80GB GPU的情况下，MeZO能够训练300亿参数的模型，而使用反向传播微调在相同预算下仅能训练27亿参数的LM。我们在不同模型类型（掩码语言模型和自回归语言模型）、模型规模（高达660亿参数）以及下游任务（分类、多选题和生成）中进行了广泛的实验。结果表明：（1）MeZO显著优于上下文学习和线性探测；（2）MeZO在多项任务中实现了与反向传播微调相当的性能，在我们当前的实现中，内存消耗最高降低了12倍，GPU小时数最高降低了2倍；（3）MeZO兼容全参数微调以及LoRA和前缀微调等高效参数微调技术；（4）MeZO能够有效地优化不可导目标（如最大化准确率或F1分数）。我们通过理论见解支持了这些实验发现，并强调了尽管经典的ZO分析认为这不可行，但充分的预训练和任务提示如何使得MeZO能够有效微调超大规模模型。

papers.abstract: Training directed neural networks typically requires forward-propagating data through a computation graph, followed by backpropagating error signal, to produce weight updates. All layers, or more generally, modules, of the network are therefore locked, in the sense that they must wait for the remainder of the network to execute forwards and propagate error backwards before they can be updated. In this work we break this constraint by decoupling modules by introducing a model of the future computation of the network graph. These models predict what the result of the modelled subgraph will produce using only local information. In particular we focus on modelling error gradients: by using the modelled synthetic gradient in place of true backpropagated error gradients we decouple subgraphs, and can update them independently and asynchronously i.e. we realise decoupled neural interfaces. We show results for feed-forward models, where every layer is trained asynchronously, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) where predicting one's future gradient extends the time over which the RNN can effectively model, and also a hierarchical RNN system with ticking at different timescales. Finally, we demonstrate that in addition to predicting gradients, the same framework can be used to predict inputs, resulting in models which are decoupled in both the forward and backwards pass -- amounting to independent networks which co-learn such that they can be composed into a single functioning corporation.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练有向神经网络通常需要通过计算图进行前向传播，随后反向传播误差信号，以产生权重更新。因此，网络的所有层（更广义地说是模块）都是被锁定的，这意味着它们必须等待网络的其余部分完成前向执行和误差反向传播后，才能进行更新。在这项工作中，我们通过引入网络图未来计算的模型来解耦模块，从而打破了这一限制。这些模型仅利用局部信息来预测建模子图的结果。我们特别关注对误差梯度的建模：通过使用建模的合成梯度（synthetic gradient）代替真实的反向传播误差梯度，我们将子图解耦，并能够独立且异步地更新它们，即实现了去耦合的神经接口。我们展示了前馈模型的结果，其中每一层都是异步训练的；在循环神经网络（RNN）中，预测自身的未来梯度扩展了 RNN 有效建模的时间跨度；此外还展示了一个在不同时间尺度上运行的分层 RNN 系统。最后，我们证明了除了预测梯度外，同样的框架还可以用于预测输入，从而产生在前向和反向传递中均被解耦的模型——这相当于相互独立的网络共同学习，使得它们能够被组合成一个单一的功能性整体。

papers.abstract: The aim of this paper is to introduce a new learning procedure for neural networks and to demonstrate that it works well enough on a few small problems to be worth further investigation. The Forward-Forward algorithm replaces the forward and backward passes of backpropagation by two forward passes, one with positive (i.e. real) data and the other with negative data which could be generated by the network itself. Each layer has its own objective function which is simply to have high goodness for positive data and low goodness for negative data. The sum of the squared activities in a layer can be used as the goodness but there are many other possibilities, including minus the sum of the squared activities. If the positive and negative passes could be separated in time, the negative passes could be done offline, which would make the learning much simpler in the positive pass and allow video to be pipelined through the network without ever storing activities or stopping to propagate derivatives.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文旨在介绍一种新的神经网络学习过程，并证明其在一些小规模问题上表现良好，值得进一步研究。Forward-Forward算法用两次前向传播替代了反向传播中的前向和反向传播过程：一次使用正向（即真实）数据，另一次使用可由网络自身生成的负向数据。每一层都有其独立的客观函数，其目标仅仅是使正向数据的“拟合度”（goodness）最大化，使负向数据的“拟合度”最小化。层内活动值的平方和可用作拟合度，当然也可以有许多其他选择，包括活动值平方和的负值。如果正向和负向传播过程能在时间上分离，负向传播便可以在离线状态下完成，这将极大地简化正向传播的学习过程，并允许视频数据以流水线方式通过网络，而无需存储活动值或停下来进行导数传播。

papers.abstract: We introduce Equilibrium Propagation, a learning framework for energy-based models. It involves only one kind of neural computation, performed in both the first phase (when the prediction is made) and the second phase of training (after the target or prediction error is revealed). Although this algorithm computes the gradient of an objective function just like Backpropagation, it does not need a special computation or circuit for the second phase, where errors are implicitly propagated. Equilibrium Propagation shares similarities with Contrastive Hebbian Learning and Contrastive Divergence while solving the theoretical issues of both algorithms: our algorithm computes the gradient of a well defined objective function. Because the objective function is defined in terms of local perturbations, the second phase of Equilibrium Propagation corresponds to only nudging the prediction (fixed point, or stationary distribution) towards a configuration that reduces prediction error. In the case of a recurrent multi-layer supervised network, the output units are slightly nudged towards their target in the second phase, and the perturbation introduced at the output layer propagates backward in the hidden layers. We show that the signal 'back-propagated' during this second phase corresponds to the propagation of error derivatives and encodes the gradient of the objective function, when the synaptic update corresponds to a standard form of spike-timing dependent plasticity. This work makes it more plausible that a mechanism similar to Backpropagation could be implemented by brains, since leaky integrator neural computation performs both inference and error back-propagation in our model. The only local difference between the two phases is whether synaptic changes are allowed or not.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation），这是一种用于能量模型的学习框架。它仅涉及一种神经计算，在训练的第一阶段（做出预测时）和第二阶段（目标或预测误差揭示后）均执行相同的计算。尽管该算法像反向传播（Backpropagation）一样计算目标函数的梯度，但它在第二阶段不需要特殊的计算或电路，因为误差是隐式传播的。平衡传播与对比赫布学习（Contrastive Hebbian Learning）和对比散度（Contrastive Divergence）有相似之处，同时解决了这两种算法的理论问题：我们的算法计算的是一个定义明确的目标函数的梯度。由于目标函数是基于局部扰动定义的，平衡传播的第二阶段仅对应于将预测（不动点或平稳分布）向减少预测误差的配置进行微调。对于递归多层监督网络，输出单元在第二阶段会向其目标轻微移动，而在输出层引入的扰动会向隐藏层反向传播。我们证明，当突触更新对应于尖峰时序依赖可塑性（STDP）的标准形式时，在此第二阶段中“反向传播”的信号对应于误差导数的传播，并编码了目标函数的梯度。这项工作使得类似于反向传播的机制在生物大脑中实现变得更加合理，因为在我们的模型中，漏积分神经计算同时执行了推理和误差反向传播。两个阶段之间唯一的局部区别在于是否允许突触发生变化。

papers.abstract: Backpropagation of error (backprop) is a powerful algorithm for training machine learning architectures through end-to-end differentiation. However, backprop is often criticised for lacking biological plausibility. Recently, it has been shown that backprop in multilayer-perceptrons (MLPs) can be approximated using predictive coding, a biologically-plausible process theory of cortical computation which relies only on local and Hebbian updates. The power of backprop, however, lies not in its instantiation in MLPs, but rather in the concept of automatic differentiation which allows for the optimisation of any differentiable program expressed as a computation graph. Here, we demonstrate that predictive coding converges asymptotically (and in practice rapidly) to exact backprop gradients on arbitrary computation graphs using only local learning rules. We apply this result to develop a straightforward strategy to translate core machine learning architectures into their predictive coding equivalents. We construct predictive coding CNNs, RNNs, and the more complex LSTMs, which include a non-layer-like branching internal graph structure and multiplicative interactions. Our models perform equivalently to backprop on challenging machine learning benchmarks, while utilising only local and (mostly) Hebbian plasticity. Our method raises the potential that standard machine learning algorithms could in principle be directly implemented in neural circuitry, and may also contribute to the development of completely distributed neuromorphic architectures.
papers.abstract_zh: 误差反向传播算法（backprop）是一种通过端到端微分来训练机器学习架构的强大算法。然而，backprop 常因缺乏生物合理性而受到批评。近期的研究表明，多层感知机（MLPs）中的 backprop 可以通过预测编码（predictive coding）进行近似；预测编码是一种基于局部和赫布（Hebbian）更新的、具有生物合理性的皮层计算过程理论。然而，backprop 的威力不在于其在 MLP 中的实现，而在于自动微分这一概念，它允许对任何表示为计算图的可微程序进行优化。在本文中，我们证明了预测编码仅利用局部学习规则，即可在任意计算图上渐近（且在实践中迅速）收敛到精确的 backprop 梯度。我们应用这一结果开发出一种简单的策略，将核心机器学习架构转化为其对应的预测编码形式。我们构建了预测编码 CNN、RNN 以及更复杂的 LSTM，后者包含了非层级的分支内部图结构和乘法交互。我们的模型在具有挑战性的机器学习基准测试中表现与 backprop 相当，同时仅利用了局部和（大部分为）赫布可塑性。我们的方法提出了这样一种可能性：标准的机器学习算法原则上可以直接在神经电路中实现，这也可能有助于开发完全分布式的神经形态架构。

papers.abstract: We explore the use of Evolution Strategies (ES), a class of black box optimization algorithms, as an alternative to popular MDP-based RL techniques such as Q-learning and Policy Gradients. Experiments on MuJoCo and Atari show that ES is a viable solution strategy that scales extremely well with the number of CPUs available: By using a novel communication strategy based on common random numbers, our ES implementation only needs to communicate scalars, making it possible to scale to over a thousand parallel workers. This allows us to solve 3D humanoid walking in 10 minutes and obtain competitive results on most Atari games after one hour of training. In addition, we highlight several advantages of ES as a black box optimization technique: it is invariant to action frequency and delayed rewards, tolerant of extremely long horizons, and does not need temporal discounting or value function approximation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了进化策略（ES）这一类黑盒优化算法的使用，将其作为 Q-learning 和策略梯度（Policy Gradients）等流行基于马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的强化学习技术的替代方案。在 MuJoCo 和 Atari 上的实验表明，ES 是一种可行的解决方案，并且能随着可用 CPU 数量的增加实现极佳的扩展：通过使用一种基于公共随机数的新型通信策略，我们的 ES 实现仅需传输标量，从而能够扩展到超过一千个并行工作节点。这使我们能够在 10 分钟内解决 3D 人形机器人行走问题，并在大多数 Atari 游戏上经过一小时的训练后获得具有竞争力的结果。此外，我们强调了 ES 作为黑盒优化技术的几个优势：它对动作频率和延迟奖励具有不变性，对极长的时间跨度具有容忍度，且不需要时间折扣或价值函数近似。

papers.abstract: Evolution Strategies (ES) is a class of powerful black-box optimisation methods that are highly parallelisable and can handle non-differentiable and noisy objectives. However, naïve ES becomes prohibitively expensive at scale on GPUs due to the low arithmetic intensity of batched matrix multiplications with unstructured random perturbations. We introduce Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning (EGGROLL), which improves arithmetic intensity by structuring individual perturbations as rank-$r$ matrices, resulting in a hundredfold increase in training speed for billion-parameter models at large population sizes, achieving up to 91% of the throughput of pure batch inference. We provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of Gaussian ES for high-dimensional parameter objectives, investigating conditions needed for ES updates to converge in high dimensions. Our results reveal a linearising effect, and proving consistency between EGGROLL and ES as parameter dimension increases. Our experiments show that EGGROLL: (1) enables the stable pretraining of nonlinear recurrent language models that operate purely in integer datatypes, (2) is competitive with GRPO for post-training LLMs on reasoning tasks, and (3) does not compromise performance compared to ES in tabula rasa RL settings, despite being faster.
papers.abstract_zh: 进化策略（ES）是一类强大的黑盒优化方法，具有高度的可并行性，并能处理不可导和带噪声的目标函数。然而，由于非结构化随机扰动的批处理矩阵乘法算术强度较低，原始的ES方法在GPU上进行大规模运算时变得极其昂贵。我们引入了基于低秩学习的进化引导通用优化（EGGROLL），通过将单个扰动结构化为秩为r的矩阵来提高算术强度，从而使十亿参数模型在大种群规模下的训练速度提高了百倍，达到了纯批处理推理吞吐量的91%。我们对高维参数目标下的高斯ES进行了严格的理论分析，探讨了ES更新在高维空间中收敛所需的条件。我们的研究结果揭示了一种线性化效应，并证明了随着参数维度的增加，EGGROLL与ES之间的一致性。实验表明，EGGROLL：（1）能够稳定预训练纯整数数据类型的非线性循环语言模型；（2）在推理任务的LLM后训练中与GRPO具有竞争力；（3）在从零开始（tabula rasa）的强化学习设置中，相比ES，在实现更高速度的同时并未牺牲性能。

papers.abstract: The backpropagation of error algorithm (BP) is impossible to implement in a real brain. The recent success of deep networks in machine learning and AI, however, has inspired proposals for understanding how the brain might learn across multiple layers, and hence how it might approximate BP. As of yet, none of these proposals have been rigorously evaluated on tasks where BP-guided deep learning has proved critical, or in architectures more structured than simple fully-connected networks. Here we present results on scaling up biologically motivated models of deep learning on datasets which need deep networks with appropriate architectures to achieve good performance. We present results on the MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet datasets and explore variants of target-propagation (TP) and feedback alignment (FA) algorithms, and explore performance in both fully- and locally-connected architectures. We also introduce weight-transport-free variants of difference target propagation (DTP) modified to remove backpropagation from the penultimate layer. Many of these algorithms perform well for MNIST, but for CIFAR and ImageNet we find that TP and FA variants perform significantly worse than BP, especially for networks composed of locally connected units, opening questions about whether new architectures and algorithms are required to scale these approaches. Our results and implementation details help establish baselines for biologically motivated deep learning schemes going forward.
papers.abstract_zh: 误差反向传播算法（BP）在真实大脑中是不可能实现的。然而，深度网络在机器学习和人工智能领域的近期成功，启发了人们去探究大脑如何进行多层学习，从而可能如何近似实现BP。迄今为止，尚未有研究在BP引导的深度学习已被证明至关重要的任务中，或在比简单全连接网络结构更复杂的架构中，对这些方案进行过严格评估。本文展示了将生物启发式深度学习模型扩展到需要合适深度架构才能获得良好性能的数据集上的结果。我们展示了在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet数据集上的实验结果，探讨了目标传播（TP）和反馈对齐（FA）算法的变体，并评估了它们在全连接和局部连接架构中的性能。我们还引入了差分目标传播（DTP）的无权重传输变体，并对其进行了修改以移除倒数第二层的反向传播。尽管许多此类算法在MNIST上表现良好，但在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上，我们发现TP和FA变体的性能明显劣于BP，特别是在由局部连接单元组成的网络中，这引发了关于是否需要新的架构和算法来扩展这些方法的质疑。我们的结果和实现细节有助于为今后生物启发式深度学习方案建立基准。

papers.abstract: The canonical deep learning approach for learning requires computing a gradient term at each block by back-propagating the error signal from the output towards each learnable parameter. Given the stacked structure of neural networks, where each block builds on the representation of the block below, this approach leads to hierarchical representations. More abstract features live on the top blocks of the model, while features on lower blocks are expected to be less abstract. In contrast to this, we introduce a new learning method named NoProp, which does not rely on either forward or backwards propagation across the entire network. Instead, NoProp takes inspiration from diffusion and flow matching methods, where each block independently learns to denoise a noisy target using only local targets and back-propagation within the block. We believe this work takes a first step towards introducing a new family of learning methods that does not learn hierarchical representations -- at least not in the usual sense. NoProp needs to fix the representation at each block beforehand to a noised version of the target, learning a local denoising process that can then be exploited at inference. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 image classification benchmarks. Our results show that NoProp is a viable learning algorithm, is easy to use and computationally efficient. By departing from the traditional learning paradigm which requires back-propagating a global error signal, NoProp alters how credit assignment is done within the network, enabling more efficient distributed learning as well as potentially impacting other characteristics of the learning process.
papers.abstract_zh: 深度学习中学习的标准方法要求通过将误差信号从输出端反向传播至每个可学习参数，从而在每个模块计算梯度项。鉴于神经网络的堆叠结构，其中每个模块都建立在下方模块的表征之上，这种方法会产生层级化的表征。更抽象的特征位于模型的顶层模块，而底层模块的特征预期抽象程度较低。相比之下，我们引入了一种名为 NoProp 的新学习方法，它不依赖于整个网络的前向或反向传播。相反，NoProp 从扩散和流匹配方法中汲取灵感，每个模块仅利用局部目标和模块内部的反向传播，独立学习去噪目标。我们认为这项工作迈出了引入一种新型学习方法的第一步，这种方法不学习层级化表征——至少不是通常意义上的层级化。NoProp 需要预先将每个模块的表征固定为目标的一个加噪版本，学习一个可在推理时利用的局部去噪过程。我们在 MNIST、CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 图像分类基准上证明了该方法的有效性。结果表明，NoProp 是一种可行的学习算法，易于使用且计算高效。通过背离需要反向传播全局误差信号的传统学习范式，NoProp 改变了网络内部信用分配的方式，实现了更高效的分布式学习，并可能影响学习过程的其他特征。

papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.
papers.abstract_zh: 模型在不可验证任务（如开放式研究）上的递归自我提升（RSI）面临着监督瓶颈，当模型的输出超过了人类专家所能可靠评估的范围时，模型本身（被优化者）就成为了现有的最佳优化器和评估者。然而，在单一模型的同质循环下，单个模型实例难以对其复杂的推理进行批判和改进。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多智能体自我监督（MASS），这是一种在演化工作流优化和基于自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替进行的RSI方法。基于多智能体拓扑结构擅长复杂推理的早期发现，MASS提示单个基础模型去迭代地提出、执行和自我评估多智能体工作流。通过受结构化护栏约束的演化搜索，模型优化了这些类似计算图的编排，为特定任务发现了最有效的分工角色和信息路由。在使用Qwen3.6-27B进行的两个MASS周期中，该模型在四个开放式公共基准测试中实现了每输出Token性能提升1.2-1.6倍。由于改进后的模型随后会成为更好的优化器和评估者，这种交替框架实现了模型能力的持续、递归自举。此外，多智能体轨迹在训练效率上也更高：在其上训练的学生模型，性能优于使用多出1.4倍训练Token进行训练的单智能体学生模型。这些发现表明，从多智能体轨迹中联合学习编排和受限的子智能体执行，可以为RSI提供有效的信号。

papers.title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 BrickBench，这是一个用于代理文本驱动的乐高套装设计的基准测试。给定一个提示，代理的任务是生成一个不仅满足语义和设计标准，而且在物理上可构建的组装方案。为此，它必须从离散的零件库中进行选择，并同时对局部和全局约束进行推理。我们在规模和零件可用性各不相同的三种设置下，对有效性、对齐度和设计质量进行了评分。我们提供了 BrickAgent，这是一个供编程代理构建、检查和验证其设计的环境。研究发现，领先的代理在很大程度上满足了可验证的物理和语义要求，但在设计水平上仍不及人类设计。我们已在 http://www.brickben.ch 发布了我们的基准测试和环境。

papers.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running $21\times$ faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running $10\times$ faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being $31\times$ faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）提供并行采样，相较于自回归模型生成速度更快，随着推理成为主要的计算负载，这一优势愈发重要。然而，DLMs 在采样步数较少时性能下降迅速，且在每一步都要处理完整序列，并需要多次遍历数据集才能达到理想质量。我们提出了下一概念建模（Next-Concept Modeling, NCM），这是一个两阶段的从粗到细框架：多尺度残差 VQ-VAE 将文本编码为离散码层次结构，Transformer 逐层生成文本，并行预测每一层内的所有码。在参数规模匹配的情况下，NCM 在 LM1B 上实现了比最强 DLM 基线更好的生成困惑度，且运行速度快了 21 倍。在 OpenWebText 上，NCM 与最强 DLM 具有竞争力，同时运行速度快了 10 倍；在 XSum 上，它在达到与最强 DLM 相同的 ROUGE-L 指标的同时，速度快了 31 倍。在数独推理任务中，NCM 在所有难度级别上均优于自回归和扩散基线，且使用的函数评估次数更少。

papers.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们如何构建一个既能超越人类语言进行思考，又能在外部环境中通过语言进行交互的智能体？现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体主要通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理（latent reasoning）提供了一种高效的内部媒介，却缺乏原生的工具调用能力和推理透明度。我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）将这两个方向结合起来，在统一的生成过程中动态切换潜在推理与基于文本的交互。在架构上，轻量级的 HybridLink 实现了文本模式与潜在模式之间的无缝转换，同时智能体的连续工作记忆在多轮对话中保留了无损的混合上下文。这些设计在保留工具集成智能体能力的同时，使潜在思维可以直接被检查。基于此架构，我们进一步开发了专门的混合推理后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过教导主干模型与 HybridLink 配合，稳定了工具集成的混合生成过程；随后 HybridRL 通过学习何时在潜在空间中思考、何时通过文本采取行动，进一步扩展了推理能力。我们在涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理的 11 个基准测试中，对 3 种模型规模的 HybridAgent 进行了评估。与涵盖基于文本和潜在方法的前沿 LLM 智能体及框架相比，HybridAgent 的性能稳定提升了 10.4%，同时实现了 35.5%-54.7% 的 Token 减少、1.8-2.6 倍的推理加速以及 2.7-3.7 倍的成本节省。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent 获取。

papers.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型中的迭代采样可能会因暴露偏差导致误差累积。去噪器在训练时使用的是真实图像与噪声的插值，但在推理阶段，其输入是由模型在先前步骤中不完美的预测构成的，这是模型在训练时从未见过的情况。这可能是扩散模型在没有额外帮助（如CFG）的情况下难以表现良好的原因之一。我们为扩散模型引入了一个校正步骤，旨在缩小这一训练与推理之间的差距。校正器以基础模型的预测作为输入，并针对相同的真实目标进行训练。这使得校正成为一项明确的学习任务，且其训练输入由基础模型提供。在采样过程中，我们在每个去噪步骤迭代地优化去噪器对清晰样本的预测。这使我们能够在中间去噪步骤纠正预测，防止早期伪影保留到最终样本中。尽管校正器仅针对基础去噪器的预测进行训练，但在推理时将其重复应用于自身输出可以获得更好的结果。这一简单的框架在很大程度上保持多样性的同时，显著提升了样本质量。我们对DiT、SiT和JiT进行了方法评估。我们的方法显著提升了此前报道的无引导生成（尤其是无条件生成）的FID分数，在无引导情况下生成高质量样本一直是一项挑战。我们的方法实现了与无分类器引导（CFG）相当的性能，并且将校正与CFG相结合，进一步提升了多样性，并减少了CFG常见的过度饱和问题。最后，我们证明了通过将优化后的预测蒸馏回基础扩散模型，可以分摊校正带来的额外推理成本，从而在没有额外推理开销的情况下保持质量增益。

VIKAVoyXi6U.video_title: Context Language Models Explained: When the Model Manages Its Own Context

papers.abstract: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了上下文语言模型（Context Language Models, CLMs），这是一种能够原生管理自身上下文的语言模型。我们的实现方式是将上下文视为一个文件，并允许模型对该文件进行不受限制的更新。这使得模型能够学习在上下文中保留哪些信息最为重要，并自然地扩展到多个智能体上下文作为文件共存的多智能体系统。使用现有模型零样本（zero-shot）构建的 CLMs 在多种任务中表现优于当前最先进（SOTA）的上下文管理策略：在 BrowseComp-Plus 上准确率提高了 11.4%，FLOPs 减少了 21.5%；在 12 小时的 EdgeBench 上得分提高了 5%，FLOPs 减少了 59%；在 24 小时的多仓库智能体群体任务中，在相同计算量下提升幅度提高了 65%。此外，通过将上下文管理从外部框架控制转移到模型的内在行为，CLMs 自然地实现了上下文管理策略的上下文内学习与参数化学习。我们证明，CLMs 可以通过在标准技能优化循环中演化出的自然语言指令进行引导，在上下文管理任务中将留出集（held-out）准确率提高了 35.9 个百分点，同时减少了计算量。我们还引入了一种用于 CLMs 的在线强化学习方法，在 BrowseComp-Plus 上使 Qwen3.5-9B 的性能提升了 47.6%，同时减少了 12% 的 FLOPs。最后，我们协同设计了用于 CLM 服务的后缀缓存重用（Suffix Cache Reuse）技术，在性能相当的情况下，相较于标准 SGLang，进一步降低了 35% 的服务端计算开销。

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI, but are constrained by limited context windows, hindering their utility in tasks like extended conversations and document analysis. To enable using context beyond limited context windows, we propose virtual context management, a technique drawing inspiration from hierarchical memory systems in traditional operating systems that provide the appearance of large memory resources through data movement between fast and slow memory. Using this technique, we introduce MemGPT (Memory-GPT), a system that intelligently manages different memory tiers in order to effectively provide extended context within the LLM's limited context window, and utilizes interrupts to manage control flow between itself and the user. We evaluate our OS-inspired design in two domains where the limited context windows of modern LLMs severely handicaps their performance: document analysis, where MemGPT is able to analyze large documents that far exceed the underlying LLM's context window, and multi-session chat, where MemGPT can create conversational agents that remember, reflect, and evolve dynamically through long-term interactions with their users. We release MemGPT code and data for our experiments at https://memgpt.ai.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）彻底改变了人工智能，但受限于有限的上下文窗口，阻碍了其在长对话和文档分析等任务中的效用。为了在有限的上下文窗口之外使用上下文，我们提出了虚拟上下文管理，这是一种借鉴了传统操作系统中分层内存系统的技术，通过在高速内存和低速内存之间进行数据移动，来模拟大容量内存资源。利用该技术，我们引入了 MemGPT（Memory-GPT）系统，它通过智能管理不同的内存层级，从而在 LLM 有限的上下文窗口内有效地提供扩展上下文，并利用中断机制来管理其与用户之间的控制流。我们在两个现代 LLM 受限于上下文窗口而表现严重不足的领域对这一受操作系统启发的设计进行了评估：一是文档分析，MemGPT 能够分析远超底层 LLM 上下文窗口的大型文档；二是多会话聊天，MemGPT 可以创建能够通过与用户的长期交互来记忆、反思并动态演化的对话智能体。我们已在 https://memgpt.ai 发布了 MemGPT 的代码及实验数据。

papers.abstract: We study allowing large language models (LLMs) to process arbitrarily long prompts through the lens of inference-time scaling. We propose Recursive Language Models (RLMs), a general inference paradigm that treats long prompts as part of an external environment and allows the LLM to programmatically examine, decompose, and recursively call itself over snippets of the prompt. We find that RLMs can successfully process inputs up to two orders of magnitude beyond model context windows and, even for shorter prompts, dramatically outperform the quality of vanilla frontier LLMs and common long-context and coding scaffolds (e.g., on GPT-5 by a median across the evaluated benchmarks of $26\%$ against compaction, $130\%$ against CodeAct with sub-calls, and $13\%$ against Claude Code) across four diverse long-context tasks while having comparable cost. At a small scale, we post-train the first model around the RLM. Our model, RLM-Qwen3-8B, outperforms the underlying Qwen3-8B model by $28.3\%$ on average and even approaches the quality of vanilla GPT-5 on three long-context tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/alexzhang13/rlm.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们从推理时扩展的视角出发，研究了如何使大语言模型（LLMs）能够处理任意长度的提示词。我们提出了递归语言模型（Recursive Language Models, RLMs），这是一种通用的推理范式，它将长提示词视为外部环境的一部分，并允许大语言模型通过编程方式检查、分解并在提示词片段上递归调用自身。研究发现，RLMs 能够成功处理超出模型上下文窗口两个数量级的输入；即使对于较短的提示词，RLMs 在四个不同的长上下文任务中，其质量也显著优于常规前沿大语言模型以及常见的长上下文和编码框架（例如，在 GPT-5 上，与压缩方法相比提升了 26%，与带有子调用的 CodeAct 相比提升了 130%，与 Claude Code 相比提升了 13%），且成本相当。在小规模实验中，我们围绕 RLM 后训练了首个模型。我们的模型 RLM-Qwen3-8B 在性能上平均超过了底层的 Qwen3-8B 模型 28.3%，并在三个长上下文任务中达到了接近常规 GPT-5 的质量。代码可在 https://github.com/alexzhang13/rlm 获取。

uD0CdMgyLQ8.video_title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation (Oct 2026)

papers.title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video generation requires denoising the current frames while writing their key-value representations as context for future predictions. However, these two roles typically share parameters, and we find that their gradients exhibit distinct patterns and systematic negative alignment, hindering the joint optimization of visual quality and temporal consistency. We introduce Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+), which assigns separate parameters to context writing and denoising while preserving their interaction through causal attention. Both roles are jointly optimized using the original generation objective without auxiliary losses, with context writing supervised through its contribution to future predictions. This simple change improves visual quality and long-horizon consistency over the evaluated baselines in both framewise and chunkwise generation, without additional video training data or a longer training horizon. Trained on only 5s rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours without long-video fine-tuning. These results highlight role-specific parameterization as an effective design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and native long-horizon extrapolation.
papers.abstract_zh: 自回归视频生成需要在去噪当前帧的同时，将其键值表示写入上下文，以供未来预测使用。然而，这两个角色通常共享参数，我们发现它们的梯度表现出截然不同的模式以及系统性的负对齐，这阻碍了视觉质量和时间一致性的联合优化。我们引入了Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+) 方法，它为上下文写入和去噪分配了独立的参数，同时通过因果注意力机制保持它们的交互。这两个角色在不使用额外辅助损失的情况下，利用原始生成目标进行联合优化，其中上下文写入通过其对未来预测的贡献进行监督。这一简单的改进在帧级和块级生成中均提升了视觉质量和长序列一致性，且无需额外的视频训练数据或更长的训练周期。SGF+ 仅在5秒的推演下进行训练，即可支持长达24小时的连续生成，而无需进行长视频微调。这些结果突显了基于角色的参数化设计是实现高质量自回归视频生成和原生长周期外推的有效设计原则。

LkTe4tZwEHs.video_title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地内置了显式的“思考模式”，然而与其对应的“不思考（no-thinking）”模式受到的关注却远少于前者。我们从两个维度研究了LLMs的“不思考”行为。a. 如何衡量“不思考”？以往研究通常通过禁用思考模式或缺乏长推理链等代理指标来定义“不思考”。这些代理指标不可靠：被禁用的思考模式仍可能产生推理内容，而长推理链可能包含填充内容而非真正的推断。因此，我们将每个回答规范化为“预回答（pre-answer）”和“最终答案”两个部分，并在三个层面进行评估：(i) 空思考率（Empty-Thinking Rate），用于评估对“仅回答”要求的严格遵从度；(ii) 指令感知下的问题-预回答相关性（Question-Pre-answer Relevance），用于衡量问题与预回答内容之间的相似度；以及 (iii) 基于LLM作为判别者的显式推理率（Explicit Inference Rate），用于检测可见的显式推理。这些指标共同区分了仅含答案的输出、相关但非推理性的文本以及显式推理。b. “不思考”如何在不同任务和模型间变化？我们在布尔题、多选题和开放式问答中，对六个LLM进行了六种提示干预评估。我们发现，显式的“不思考”控制无法可靠地消除可见的推理。相反，模型表现出一种“思考惯性（Thinking Inertia）”：即便在严格控制下，显式推理依然存在，且随着答案空间的扩大而变得更加普遍。在布尔题和多选题中，准确率保持稳定；但在开放式任务中，遵从“仅回答”要求与任务准确率之间存在权衡。通过跨答案空间重写相同问题，我们发现提供候选答案能使生成“仅回答”的响应变得更容易。这些发现表明，“不思考”是一种不容小觑的能力：不能仅凭模型设置或指令就假设模型停止了显式推理，它应当与推理能力一起被纳入系统性评估。

mDmy1ZAS6hg.video_title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State (Oct 2026)

papers.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.
papers.abstract_zh: 状态空间模型（SSMs）维护一个固定大小的循环状态，但在每个解码步骤对其进行读写可能会成为混合模型的瓶颈。这种迫切的状态管理导致了高状态I/O与低算术强度的矛盾，使得投机解码无法进行低成本回滚，并将状态量化误差引入后续的循环更新中。我们引入了ReplaySSM，通过展开循环将状态表示为一个检查点和一个近期SSM输入缓冲区。这实现了输出计算与检查点更新的分离。通过周期性更新检查点，ReplaySSM避免了大多数步骤中的状态写入，并使主要的状态内存流量减少了约一半。保留近期输入还使得投机回滚变成了一种缓冲区指针操作，并实现了无需实例化中间状态的仅输出验证。同样的分离允许低精度检查点在大多数步骤中服务于输出计算，而高精度检查点则用于循环更新，从而确保低精度副本中的舍入误差不会进入后续更新。我们在vLLM中为Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet实现了ReplaySSM。在服务批处理大小为256的情况下，它在四种混合模型上比调整后的vLLM基线加速了标准解码 $1.20$–$1.47	imes$，并在两个120B级模型上提供了vLLM投机解码约 $1.8	imes$ 的吞吐量。与共享低精度检查点相比，独立的状态精度还降低了输出KL散度和下游精度损失。

zWEl_nn5zDc.video_title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs (Oct 2026)

papers.title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. On behavior cloning tasks in simulation and physical robots, LeWAM is also competitive with established methods. Interpretability analyses show that LeWAM learns control-relevant representations and action distributions effectively guiding test-time planning and control.
papers.abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）可以在无需像素重建的情况下学习紧凑的潜在世界模型。现有的 JEPA 流水线通常在添加控制策略或求解器之前，先训练视觉表征和动作条件下的动力学模型。我们引入了 LeWAM，这是一个用于控制的端到端 JEPA，其特点包括：（1）针对下一潜在状态预测和动作流匹配的联合训练目标，以及（2）对潜在状态施加各向同性高斯约束，使单个模型能够通过评估采样动作及其学习到的潜在动力学，实现直接的策略执行和高效规划。在视觉规划任务中，与此前的 JEPA 相比，LeWAM 在接触丰富的任务上将成功率从 28.6% 提高到 89.7%，在长程任务上从 10.9% 提高到 46.2%，且规划速度提升了 32.3 倍。在模拟环境和实体机器人的行为克隆任务中，LeWAM 也展现出了与成熟方法相当的竞争力。可解释性分析表明，LeWAM 学习到的控制相关表征和动作分布能够有效地指导测试时的规划与控制。

Kd7LpZV6AiM.video_title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Cowork agents navigate dependencies across tools and files while adapting to changing user requirements and edits to shared workspaces. Scaling such environments requires maintaining consistency among task objectives, executable resources, user behavior, and success criteria. We introduce Cowork-Gym, a framework that synthesizes Cowork environments through a build-execute-revise loop that uses execution evidence and review feedback to validate and repair generated environments. To capture realistic Cowork dynamics, a stateful user simulator responds to the agent's actions through dialogue and direct edits to the shared workspace. We synthesize 64.9K environments across 14 application scenarios and use them to post-train 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B Qwen models with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Averaged across six agentic benchmarks, these models outperform their corresponding base checkpoints by 8.7, 6.4, and 4.1 points, respectively. Ours-27B ranks second overall among the evaluated models and achieves the highest average scores on PawBench and ClawEval, outperforming models with over 100B total parameters on both benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 协作智能体（Cowork agents）需要在应对不断变化的用户需求和共享工作区编辑的同时，管理跨工具和文件的依赖关系。扩展此类环境需要保持任务目标、可执行资源、用户行为和成功标准之间的一致性。我们引入了 Cowork-Gym，这是一个通过构建-执行-修订（build-execute-revise）循环来合成 Cowork 环境的框架，利用执行证据和审查反馈来验证并修复生成的环境。为了捕捉真实的协作动态，一个有状态的用户模拟器通过对话和对共享工作区的直接编辑来响应智能体的操作。我们跨 14 个应用场景合成了 64.9K 个环境，并使用它们通过监督微调、强化学习和策略内蒸馏（on-policy distillation）对 9B、27B 和 35B-A3B Qwen 模型进行了后训练。在六个智能体基准测试中，这些模型的平均得分比其对应的基础检查点分别提高了 8.7、6.4 和 4.1 分。Ours-27B 在所有被评估模型中总排名第二，并在 PawBench 和 ClawEval 上取得了最高的平均分，在这两个基准测试中均优于参数总量超过 100B 的模型。

lko6nKftDYg.video_title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck (Oct 2026)

papers.title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. In real settings, a single true evaluation, such as a full benchmark or serving trace, can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful of true evaluations. We present DuoDiscover, a search system that jointly discovers what to optimize and how to evaluate progress efficiently, through three mechanisms. First, each worker in a fleet of coding agents co-discovers an optimization target and a fast, tailored proxy evaluator, which we call a yardstick. The agent then hill-climbs the yardstick rather than the true evaluation. Second, since search can exploit gaps between a yardstick and the true objective, fidelity tests continually recheck each yardstick's ranking and invalidate any that drift. Third, the fleet is bottom-up, with no central decomposition of the problem. A lightweight orchestrator spawns and terminates agents, briefs running ones, and seeds new agents with others' confirmed work. DuoDiscover enables autonomous optimization from software to chip architecture. We demonstrate DuoDiscover on two repository-level benchmarks and four GPU and TPU kernel suites covering hundreds of kernels. On SWE-fficiency, it doubles the average speedup of human experts. On SOL-Exec, it ranks first on 121 of 235 kernels and in the top three on 212. On the heavily optimized vLLM and SQLite engines, DuoDiscover achieves 1.92$\times$ and 1.38$\times$ gains over the base code. On a CPU microarchitecture optimization task with evaluations of up to 28 hours, DuoDiscover surpasses both AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and the best human design, with 1.65$\times$ ArchAgent v2's gain in 16.7 days versus more than 40 days, advancing the frontier of autonomous chip design.
papers.abstract_zh: 评估一直是人工智能进步的核心，对于自主发现也同样至关重要。然而，将自主发现扩展到现实世界的工程挑战面临一个根本性的瓶颈：评估进展的成本。在实际场景中，一次完整的评估（例如完整的基准测试或服务追踪）可能需要数小时，因此搜索过程往往只能负担得起少数几次真实评估。我们提出了 DuoDiscover，这是一个通过三种机制联合发现优化目标并高效评估进展的搜索系统。首先，编码智能体集群中的每个智能体都会共同发现一个优化目标和一个快速、定制的代理评估器（我们称之为“标尺”）。随后，智能体对该标尺而非真实评估指标进行爬山搜索。其次，由于搜索过程可能会利用标尺与真实目标之间的偏差，保真度测试会持续重新检查每个标尺的排序，并使任何出现偏移的标尺失效。第三，该集群采用自下而上的方式，无需对问题进行中央分解。一个轻量级的编排器负责启动和终止智能体、向运行中的智能体下达指令，并利用其他智能体已确认的成果来引导新智能体。DuoDiscover 实现了从软件到芯片架构的自主优化。我们在两个代码库级别的基准测试和涵盖数百个内核的四个 GPU 及 TPU 内核套件上展示了 DuoDiscover 的性能。在 SWE-fficiency 上，它使人类专家的平均加速比翻了一番。在 SOL-Exec 上，它在 235 个内核中的 121 个上排名第一，在 212 个内核上排名前三。在经过深度优化的 vLLM 和 SQLite 引擎上，DuoDiscover 分别比基础代码实现了 1.92 倍和 1.38 倍的性能提升。在一项评估时长长达 28 小时的 CPU 微架构优化任务中，DuoDiscover 表现超过了基于 AlphaEvolve 的 ArchAgent v2 和最优人类设计，在 16.7 天内取得了 ArchAgent v2 超过 40 天所达到的 1.65 倍增益，推动了自主芯片设计的前沿发展。

QqcTXtheUnQ.video_title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了基于物理特性的铰接式3D资产生成，旨在将研究目标从再现物体外观转向捕捉其运动和功能。受程序化和代理生成文献的启发，我们提出了Artisan，这是一个扩展了最新方法Articraft的系统。通过引入带有物理模拟反馈的多智能体流程，该系统在几何形状、外观和物理可信的铰接结构之外，实现了更全面的属性，例如无碰撞运动、重力下的稳定性以及精确的质量和材料属性。此外，我们构建了一个涵盖四个关键维度的统一基准：空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务性能和整体质量。该基准包含来自ArtVIP和LightWheel的100个参考资产、50个稳定性提示词以及50个具有参考质量的ABO物体，并制定了评估各项指标的协议。通过对超过10个代表性模型的广泛评估，Artisan在实现具有竞争力的空间保真度的同时，在所有评估方法中达到了最低的碰撞率和最高的稳定性。总之，我们的系统和基准测试为推动3D生成向物理可信、功能可用的资产发展提供了深刻见解。

oisC-7rmuaw.video_title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Agent environments are essential for large language model (LLM) development. They use programmatic verifiers to turn complex outcomes into rewards. Verifiers can be attacked into awarding full credit to cheating agents without completing the intended task, causing inaccurate evaluation and misalignment in training. As agent environments scale in numbers and difficulty, so must the repairing of exploitable verifiers. To this end, we ask whether today's model with scaled compute can automatically harden agent environments to prevent potentially stronger future models from reward hacking. We introduce a scalable, fully automatic approach to weak-to-strong verifier hardening. It first sets up an isolated verifier sandbox that agents cannot directly modify, then uses a hacker-fixer loop to find and repair remaining verifier vulnerabilities. We apply this loop to Terminal Bench, KernelBench, and SETA, substantially reducing attack success across these agent environments. The iterative design scales with the hardening budget, producing progressively stronger defenses as the number of loop iterations increases and outperforming the static, non-iterative baseline. An earlier version of our hacker-fixer loop has been adopted by the official Terminal Bench repository as a way to audit exploits in its environments. Project page: https://verifier-hardening.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 智能体环境对于大语言模型（LLM）的开发至关重要。它们利用程序化验证器将复杂的执行结果转化为奖励。然而，验证器可能受到攻击，使得作弊的智能体无需完成预定任务即可获得满分，从而导致评估不准确和训练中的对齐偏差。随着智能体环境在数量和难度上的扩展，修复易受攻击的验证器也变得同等重要。为此，我们探讨了当前具备大规模算力的模型是否能够自动加固智能体环境，以防止未来更强大的模型进行奖励欺诈。我们引入了一种可扩展、全自动的弱模型到强模型验证器加固方法。该方法首先建立一个智能体无法直接修改的隔离验证器沙箱，然后利用“黑客-修复者”循环来发现并修复残留的验证器漏洞。我们将此循环应用于 Terminal Bench、KernelBench 和 SETA，显著降低了这些智能体环境中的攻击成功率。这种迭代设计能够随着加固预算的增加而扩展，随着循环迭代次数的增加，防御能力会逐步增强，且表现优于静态的非迭代基准方法。我们“黑客-修复者”循环的早期版本已被 Terminal Bench 官方仓库采纳，用于审计其环境中的漏洞。项目主页：https://verifier-hardening.github.io/。

papers.title: Interaction-as-a-Judge (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Coding agents are tasked with producing sophisticated interactive applications such as websites, desktop applications, and games. While humans assess these applications interactively, current automated LLM evaluations primarily focus on code analysis and unit tests. This mismatch can cause LLM judges to miss failures that are immediately apparent to human users. We study Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents (CUAs) directly interact with an application. We demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can improve both evaluation and generation of interactive applications. To this end, we collect and release two complementary datasets: $6,858$ pairs of applications with human preferences and corresponding agent traces, and $222$ applications with human-verified requirement labels. Relative to standard non-interactive approaches, we find that Interaction-as-a-Judge improves evaluation in terms of predicting human preferences ($65.6\% \to 69.1\%$) and requirement verification ($77.0\% \to 81.6\%$). We also observe scaling benefits: across both preference alignment and requirement verification, higher-quality interactions improve performance. Finally, through both inference- and training-time experiments, we demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can also improve the quality of generated artifacts. At inference time, Interaction-as-a-Judge repairs $75.5\%$ of broken requirements within five attempts, compared to $55.4\%$ for code-only self-feedback. At training time, using Interaction-as-a-Judge as a reward signal improves win-rate over the base model by $6.7$pp while reducing both generated code length by $35.7\%$ and build failure rates by $7.2$pp compared to a code-only reward signal.
papers.abstract_zh: 编程智能体（Coding agents）的任务是开发复杂的交互式应用程序，如网站、桌面应用和游戏。尽管人类是通过交互来评估这些应用的，但当前自动化的LLM评估主要侧重于代码分析和单元测试。这种错位可能导致LLM判别器忽略人类用户一眼就能看出的故障。我们研究了“交互作为判别器”（Interaction-as-a-Judge），这是一种计算机使用智能体（CUA）直接与应用程序交互的评估范式。我们证明，“交互作为判别器”可以同时提升交互式应用程序的评估和生成效果。为此，我们收集并发布了两个互补的数据集：包含6,858对带有用户偏好和对应智能体轨迹的应用程序，以及222个带有经人工验证需求标签的应用程序。与标准的非交互式方法相比，我们发现“交互作为判别器”在预测人类偏好（从65.6%提升至69.1%）和需求验证（从77.0%提升至81.6%）方面的评估效果更佳。我们还观察到了规模化效益：在偏好对齐和需求验证方面，更高质量的交互都能带来性能提升。最后，通过推理时和训练时的实验，我们证明“交互作为判别器”还能提高生成产物的质量。在推理阶段，“交互作为判别器”能在五次尝试内修复75.5%的需求故障，而仅基于代码的自我反馈修复率为55.4%。在训练阶段，使用“交互作为判别器”作为奖励信号，相比仅使用代码奖励信号，胜率提升了6.7个百分点，同时生成代码长度减少了35.7%，构建失败率降低了7.2个百分点。

Ja8Rq4WgEsY.video_title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization.
