For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于自监督表示学习的方法，旨在将其作为生成建模的标记器（tokenizer）。我们的目标是通过对数据点互信息进行因式分解来监督表示损失，该互信息是通过计算学习到的生成模型中条件预测之间的信息差异来估算的。我们在理论和实证上证明了该算法的有效性，并表明我们的生成式表示学习方法避免了在 DINO 和 LeJEPA 等常用方法失效情况下的维度坍塌和特征抑制问题。此外，我们证明了该表示学习技术具有可扩展性；投入更多的计算资源可以预见地带来更好的潜在标记化效果。我们首次对标记器和生成模型的综合 FLOP 效率进行了细致分析，证明了与直接在像素空间进行扩散生成相比，我们的方法在计算上是一种更优的改进，使用 JiT-L 获得了 2.18 的 FID-50K 分数。在应用于 ImageNet 和文本到图像数据集 GPIC 时，我们展示了标记器编码器在可扩散性方面的缩放定律（scaling laws），其中外推我们的方法在 ImageNet 上比 DINOv2 减少了 7 倍的 FLOPs，在 GPIC 上比 WebSSL 减少了 8 倍的 FLOPs。

SLmJDcQO9d8.video_title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.
papers.abstract_zh: 基础模型正在推动机器人智能的范式转变，从底层的动作预测转向数据收集、模型训练、任务规划和真实世界执行的目标导向式编排。我们将这种新兴范式定义为“智能体机器人”（agentic robots），在这种范式下，智能体能够理解人类指令、与机器人环境交互、自主纠正执行错误，并动态调整操作策略。尽管该领域发展迅速，但当前研究之间缺乏紧密联系，研究人员对于如何将不同的智能体功能整合进一个完整的机器人系统中尚未形成统一的认识。本文对智能体机器人的现有研究进行了统一概述。我们首先追溯了从机器人策略到智能体系统的演进过程，涵盖了视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）、世界模型和世界-动作模型。随后，我们明确了智能体机器人的定义与范畴，并将现有研究归纳为四个功能领域下的十七个类别：模型（Model）、数据（Data）、环境（Environment）和调度（Harness）。在这些领域中，我们探讨了智能体如何塑造模型学习与机器人决策、如何收集与筛选机器人数据、如何构建用于学习与评估的世界、任务及测试，以及如何组织用于机器人使用的能力。最后，我们讨论了当前面临的挑战并指出了未来的研究方向。展望未来，我们希望这项工作能够促进对智能体机器人的清晰理解，并为开发更具能力、可靠性和适应性的机器人系统提供新思路。

5wM3zyXQ9Iw.video_title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators (Oct 2026)

papers.title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.
papers.abstract_zh: 科学领域的生成式发现需要将高层科学推理与生成符合设计空间结构样本的能力相结合。然而，目前这两项能力在很大程度上仍是分离的：基础大语言模型（LLM）编码了广泛的化学和生物学知识，而特定领域的流模型（flow-based）和扩散模型（diffusion-based）生成器则捕获了生成有效序列和几何结构所需的先验知识。我们研究了如何在不需要显式代理奖励（在实验科学中，这种奖励通常不可用或难以被学习预测器准确捕获）的情况下，将此类科学生成器与高层自然语言发现目标相对齐。我们引入了LLM-to-Flow蒸馏（LFD）方法，由冻结的LLM充当特定领域生成器的自适应教师。给定诸如“生成具有潜力抗癌活性的肽”之类的目标，教师会根据生成器当前的能力构建一系列中间子目标课程，并逐步引导它们实现最初的发现目标。在每一轮中，LLM会对当前目标下的采样候选者进行评估。这些评估产生偏好，并通过DPO（直接偏好优化）迭代地蒸馏到生成器中。即使初始模型对满足最终目标的设计赋予的概率微乎其微，该程序也能提供密集的学习信号，从而实现向覆盖不足的分布外区域的适配。在治疗性肽和小分子结构设计上的实验表明，LFD实现了一种新的生成控制形式：将任意特定领域的科学生成器与通过高层自然语言目标表达的科学发现任务相对齐。

papers.title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation? (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming.
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型和流匹配目前是连续域生成建模的主流框架，但它们通常需要在推理时进行多次网络评估。这推动了主要基于扩散和流的单步生成建模的广泛研究，尽管现有方法往往依赖于复杂的训练机制。在这项工作中，我们引入了 Priming Models，这是一个用于训练单步生成器的简单两阶段框架。受从零开始进行分布训练困难性的启发，Priming Models 首先在重构目标（例如固定噪声水平下的像素空间去噪）上进行训练，然后再进行特征空间的分布后训练。我们的核心科学发现是，这一简单的重构阶段已足以完全缓解分布训练的难度。在实验上，跨类别条件图像生成、文本到图像生成以及世界建模任务中，Priming Models 显著提升了训练计算量与生成质量之间的帕累托前沿。在 $256 \times 256$ 分辨率的 ImageNet 上，我们实现了 $1.19$ 的 FID，在同类单步生成器中达到领先水平，且其训练计算量仅为先前具有可比 FID 方法的约十分之一。我们已将代码库开源至 https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming。

WX6m4ofbgIA.video_title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.
papers.abstract_zh: 从头蛋白质设计的一个核心挑战在于生成具有特定结构和功能属性的蛋白质。现有的设计模型通常需要针对每种属性设置专门的输入表示，这限制了它们所能支持的设计目标。我们开发了 Prompteina，这是首个支持通过自然语言指定全新且更广泛设计目标的全原子结构生成模型，类似于文本到图像的生成方式。为了训练 Prompteina，我们构建了 Prompteina-Data，这是一个包含 180 万个结构和超过 5000 万条描述全局及残基特定结构与功能属性的文本-蛋白质结构配对数据集。我们通过文本条件预训练和微调对预训练结构生成模型 Proteina-Complexa 进行了改造，使残基与其对应的文本对齐。Prompteina 在 18 项结构属性中的 15 项上表现优于基线模型，并能生成与预期功能描述更贴合的蛋白质。在结合物设计任务中，它在 20 个目标中的至少 13 个上领先于基线，并将界面置信度较最强基线提升了 14%。通过迭代式的计算机模拟反馈，Prompteina 在最困难的目标上，其相对于非迭代生成的增益比次优基线高出 57%。最后，我们针对 GM2A（一个尚无从头结合物报道的靶点）对 Prompteina 的设计进行了实验验证。我们鉴定出 9 种结合物，其中最强的一种表观 $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ 为 107 nM。这些结果确立了自然语言作为一种有效且强大的蛋白质结构生成条件化接口的地位。

PXodjLzVt3M.video_title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft (Oct 2026)

papers.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在沙盒版《我的世界》（Minecraft）生存模式中部署了四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体，并设定了一个目标：击败末影龙。每个智能体通过名为 Mineflayer 的开源库控制一名玩家，并利用游戏内聊天和共享内存与队友进行协作。没有人为其分配角色或编写游戏逻辑。智能体自行规划、编写并调试了所有程序。研究人员可以通过实时仪表板观察运行过程，并随时暂停或停止，但全程无需干预。从“简单”难度的随机生成世界开始，该团队共编写了 2,783 个程序，最终在 27 小时 14 分钟内击败了末影龙，期间共死亡 605 次。据我们所知，这是 AI 智能体首次在不使用预先探测的种子或其他由人类编写的特定游戏工具的情况下，仅依靠标准的 Mineflayer 库实现《我的世界》的端到端自主通关。要获胜，智能体需要在超过一天的时间里，在数千个相互依赖的步骤中保持连贯的计划。复杂的现实世界软件工程和企业任务同样需要这种长周期的编码和多智能体协作能力。我们详细描述了实验设置、运行过程、团队策略（分工、共享所学知识、相互回收物品）以及该结果的局限性。

WtVZEtIRFF4.video_title: AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents (Oct 2026)

papers.title: AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Terminal agents solve tasks in software engineering and scientific research by executing commands in a terminal. Training them via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse and verifiable environments, but these environments are still mostly designed by human researchers, so their supply grows only as fast as researchers can work. We introduce AutoEnvScaling, which treats environment design as a terminal task and uses agents to automate the data flywheel. A proposer agent builds new RL environments from the rollouts of the solver being trained, and the solver's new rollouts guide the next round. By turning environment generation into a terminal task, AutoEnvScaling increases the valid-environment rate by up to 25 times compared to prompt-only generation, at up to 75% lower cost per valid environment. We show that training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoEnvScaling environments from GPT-5.6-sol improves its Terminal-Bench 2.1 score by 4.3 points over the matched Tmax baseline. The broader goal of AutoEnvScaling is to enable recursive self-improvement (RSI): by making both environment generation and solving terminal tasks, it lets one model co-evolve in both roles. We show that Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, acting in both roles, gains 12.2 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and raises its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score from 1.6 to 3.2. The pipeline also generalizes across agentic domains, generating environments for software engineering, computer use, professional work, and GPU kernel programming. Overall, these results show a path toward agents building their own training environments, reducing human reliance and taking a core step toward RSI.
papers.abstract_zh: 终端智能体通过在终端中执行命令来解决软件工程和科学研究中的任务。通过强化学习（RL）训练这些智能体需要多样化且可验证的环境，但这些环境目前大多由人类研究人员设计，因此其供给增长速度受限于研究人员的工作效率。我们提出了 AutoEnvScaling，它将环境设计视为一项终端任务，并利用智能体来自动化数据飞轮。提议者智能体（Proposer agent）根据正在训练的求解器（Solver）的运行轨迹构建新的 RL 环境，而求解器的新运行轨迹则指导下一轮循环。通过将环境生成转化为终端任务，与仅使用提示词（Prompt-only）的生成方法相比，AutoEnvScaling 将有效环境生成率提高了多达 25 倍，且每个有效环境的成本降低了多达 75%。我们展示了在由 GPT-5.6-sol 生成的 AutoEnvScaling 环境上训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，其 Terminal-Bench 2.1 分数较匹配的 Tmax 基线提升了 4.3 分。AutoEnvScaling 的更广泛目标是实现递归自我改进（RSI）：通过使环境生成和求解过程都成为终端任务，它允许单一模型在两个角色中共同进化。我们展示了 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在同时扮演这两个角色时，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上获得了 12.2 分的提升，并将 Terminal-Bench 4.0 的分数从 1.6 提高到了 3.2。该流水线还推广到了不同的智能体领域，为软件工程、计算机使用、专业工作和 GPU 内核编程生成了环境。总的来说，这些结果展示了一条通往智能体构建自身训练环境的路径，减少了对人类的依赖，并向实现 RSI 迈出了核心一步。

ktUmhY5soRA.video_title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction (Oct 2026)

papers.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉智能体必须将视频观测结果转化为及时的决策，以跟踪进度并选择下一步行动。基于新兴的“系统一”（System One）范式，我们推出了 VideoJev，这是一个将视频理解与交互视为结构化决策任务的模型系列。我们对预训练的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行了改造，通过一个共享头替换了自回归答案解码，该共享头根据视频证据对时间区间和文本选项进行评分。这些分数可以生成事件区间或多项选择答案，从而统一了时间定位（temporal grounding）和多项选择视频问答任务。这种方法结合了 MLLMs 的语义灵活性与智能体可直接使用的高效决策能力。随着交互的展开，新的目标和中间结果会触发对同一视觉历史的进一步查询。因此，VideoJev 通过“缓存推理”（Cached inference）来处理即时到来的查询，并通过“联合推理”（Joint inference）在单次前向传递中处理多个查询，从而复用视觉计算。在三个时间定位基准测试中，VideoJev-4B 和 VideoJev-35B-A3B 的平均 mIoU 比其基座模型分别提高了 6.7 和 10.8 个点，推理速度提升了 2.8 到 3.1 倍。在四个视频问答基准测试中，两者在“思考模式”（Thinking mode）下均达到了与基座模型相当的性能，且推理速度提升超过 100 倍。这些结果提供了一个统一的、可复用的决策接口，用于将结构化的视觉判断组合成复杂的、开放式的工作流。

papers.title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.
papers.abstract_zh: Flow matching 已成为训练高质量生成模型的一种可扩展范式，但从学习到的概率流中进行采样需要多次网络评估。蒸馏可以将此成本降低至一次或少数几次评估；然而，单步生成往往会牺牲质量，使得少步生成成为实际应用中的运行模式。现有的少步方法沿着概率流执行迭代计算，因此需要固定且人工选择的时间步离散化。这种离散化通常是根据经验选择的，且调整成本高昂；当样本或空间位置之间的细化难度不同时，它也可能具有限制性。我们引入了数据空间迭代（data-space iteration），这是一种去除了流离散化的少步生成框架。从噪声出发，共享生成器直接在数据空间中细化其预测，并对每次迭代进行训练，以产生在其容量允许范围内的最佳样本。我们的公式以极小的改动即可与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）相结合，从而能够在匹配的训练设置下对不同迭代方法进行受控比较。在类别条件 ImageNet 256x256 上，数据空间迭代的表现优于标准的离散化基线，并且在无需针对特定调度进行训练的情况下，匹配或改进了通过调度搜索选择的变体。这些结果表明，对于快速生成而言，数据空间迭代提供了一种简单且有效的替代离散化流空间迭代的方法。

papers.title: World Modeling Through Spectral Alignment (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们该如何告诉世界模型需要保留哪些信息？本文通过谱表示学习（spectral representation learning）的视角研究了这一问题。我们引入了 SpecWM，这是一种 JEPA 框架，它通过目标相似度核（target similarity kernel）明确指定观测值之间预期的关系，并训练编码器在嵌入几何空间中复现这些关系。不同的核提供不同的监督信号，从物理状态信息到仅需观测值轨迹顺序的完全自监督时间核（temporal kernel）。我们刻画了该目标的全局最优解，建立了线性可恢复性（linear recoverability）和对干扰信息不变性的条件，并在理想化设置下将时间核相似度与行为后继测度（behavioral successor measure）联系起来。实验表明，核的选择强烈影响了从表示中可恢复的物理量。更重要的是，时间谱对齐（temporal spectral alignment）将 CEM 规划在 OGBench Cube 上的成功率从 52% 提升至 68%，在 OGBench Scene 上从 49% 提升至 77%，在 CALVIN 上从 29% 提升至 51%，均优于 LeWorldModel。这些结果表明，明确指定表示几何结构为引导潜在世界模型保留用于控制的信息提供了一种简便方法。

5zt6eXbPytQ.video_title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: System one模型能够实现直接、低延迟的决策。然而，当前通过序列化文本预测答案的做法本身并未遵循决策问题的结构。我们认为，当前的设计忽视了四个重要的结构要求：（i）null-aware（空值感知）：模型应区分答案缺失与候选对象间的不确定性；（ii）permutation-invariant（排列不变性）：重新排序候选选项不应改变决策结果；（iii）option-scalable（选项可扩展性）：候选集规模的扩大不应要求重新定义输出空间；（iv）cacheable（可缓存性）：针对重复选项的请求独立计算应能在不同请求间重用。我们引入了Jeva，这是一种共同解决这些要求的决策原生架构。共享编码器分别对请求和每个选项进行表征，而紧凑的决策栈仅在不可变的选项内存基础上优化请求状态。对称聚合产生了排列等变的概率；共享评分机制适应了可变规模的候选集。独立的覆盖率估计将答案缺失与候选竞争区分开来，从而实现了明确的空值输出。请求独立的选项表征和层投影支持在重新组合的集合间进行重用。这些机制统一了Choice、Noul和Score输出。在评估中，Jeva结合了强大的类型化决策性能与近乎完美的空值检测，且在任何测试的排列下均未发生决策翻转。它能够扩展到数千个候选对象，并通过跨请求重用在不改变决策的前提下显著降低了延迟。

B3qz6LFRNUY.video_title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifier. Across a range of tasks and scales, we train models that largely preserve their task-solving capability while selectively falling back when acting would be unreliable. More broadly, our results show that reinforcement learning can not only incentivize models to succeed, but also to reason about the limits of their capabilities and change course when they determine that success is out of reach.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习使语言模型在解决任务时表现更佳，但同样的机制也会奖励猜测行为。当成功是获取奖励的唯一途径时，选择安全的回退策略总是比孤注一掷的尝试要差。然而，当错误的操作可能导致数据库损坏或发布错误代码时，这种激励机制可能会带来沉重代价。因此，我们提出训练模型以实现“优雅失败”（fail gracefully）：在尽可能保持成功行为的同时，学习在执行操作不可靠时采取安全的回退策略。然而，由于优化动态的不利因素，单纯使用带有中间奖励的回退行为策略梯度法显得十分脆弱。我们通过 GracefulRL 解决了这一挑战，它通过重塑优化地形来促进优雅失败。重要的是，这种行为直接源于结果层面的奖励信号，无需指定何时回退的标注，也无需在推理时使用验证器等额外机制。在一系列任务和规模的实验中，我们训练出的模型在很大程度上保留了任务解决能力，同时能在操作不可靠时有选择性地进行回退。从更广泛的意义上讲，我们的结果表明，强化学习不仅可以激励模型取得成功，还可以激励模型对其能力局限进行推理，并在确定无法成功时改变策略。

jMokdur7oWg.video_title: VLA-$Δ$: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models (Oct 2026)

papers.title: VLA-$Δ$: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-$Δ$, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-$Δ$ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms $π_{0.5}$ in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉-语言预训练中获得的语义知识迁移到机器人控制中，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能。然而，大多数VLA模型直接将观测映射为演示动作，而缺乏对中间物理状态变化的显式监督，这使其容易对“观测-动作”的对应关系产生过拟合。一些方法通过在语言、视觉或潜在空间中引入中间推理或未来状态预测来指导动作生成，但并未对物理状态转换本身进行显式监督。因此，我们提出了VLA-$Δ$，这是一个将当前状态与未来状态之间的物理变化作为显式学习目标的通用框架。为支持该目标，我们构建了一个大规模预训练数据集，并推导了涵盖任务相关语义和视觉运动变化的物理状态转换标注，为连续动作生成提供了更直接的监督。在推理过程中，模型无需额外的推理开销，即可直接根据当前观测生成动作。VLA-$Δ$在LIBERO和RoboTwin上达到了与现有最先进方法（SOTA）相当的性能，并在真实机器人实验中超越了$π_{0.5}$。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta 开源。

t6CcpqPFV0U.video_title: Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. For such cases, CaRe computes a residual direction from the discrepancy between the counterfactual and fused representations and uses it to steer the original multimodal state toward the relevant modality evidence, while retaining both modalities in the original audio-visual inference path. The intervention strength is adapted based on the confidence of the counterfactual branch. Experiments on CMM and AVHBench across two OLLMs show that CaRe consistently outperforms the evaluated inference-time hallucination-mitigation baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）在视听干扰下容易产生跨模态幻觉。我们发现，在很大一部分错误的联合预测中，与问题相关的单模态分支仍然可以得出正确答案，这表明即使任务相关证据未体现在联合预测中，也可以从相关模态中恢复出来。我们将这种可恢复的失败模式称为“模态误导”（modality misrouting）。我们提出了 CaRe（冲突感知残差干预），这是一种无需训练的推理时方法，用于识别和纠正模态误导。CaRe 使用仅基于文本的模态探测器来识别候选的模态特定反事实分支，并在其预测与原始联合预测冲突时标记潜在的误导情况。对于此类情况，CaRe 通过反事实表征与融合表征之间的差异计算残差方向，并利用该方向引导原始多模态状态向相关的模态证据靠拢，同时在原始视听推理路径中保留两个模态。干预强度根据反事实分支的置信度进行自适应调整。在两个 OLLM 上针对 CMM 和 AVHBench 进行的实验表明，CaRe 在性能上持续优于评估的推理时幻觉缓解基准方法。

V7Xgk2ROeXI.video_title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine

papers.title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Hard. On LHTB, process reward rises from 0.21 to 0.37 and strict completion from 0/46 to 5/46; SWR100 success doubles from 3.00% to 6.00%. By recursively coupling verified trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement, each retained stage consolidates discovered behaviors and progressively advances the agent from partial local repairs to strict terminal verification.
papers.abstract_zh: 将验证器结果转化为有效的策略更新，并将部分进展转化为完整的任务解决，对于终端智能体（terminal agents）至关重要。我们提出了 Terminal-RSI，它将经过验证轨迹的递归自我重写（Recursive Self-Rewrite, RSR）与继承评价模型的递归策略优化（Recursive Policy-Refine, RPR）交替进行。我们制定了回合边界跳跃观察广义优势估计（Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE, TB-GAE），在应用跨交互回合衰减的同时保留特定于标记的基线。族密集奖励（Family Dense Reward, FDR）校准了跨任务族的语义进展；成功优先奖励（Success-Prioritized Reward, SPR）将严格的成功与有界的部分得分区分开来。预热评价模型、递归评价模型移交以及阶段特定的学习率协调了这两个优化阶段。从 Qwen3.8-27B 基础模型开始，经过 RSR-1、RPR-1、RSR-2 和 RPR-2 的五阶段序列，最终得到了 Terminal-RSI-27B：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上达到 19.84%，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 86.52%，在 Terminal-Bench 3.0 上达到 16.95%，在 Terminal-Bench Hard 上达到 79.00%。在 LHTB 上，过程奖励从 0.21 上升至 0.37，严格完成率从 0/46 提高至 5/46；SWR100 成功率翻倍，从 3.00% 提升至 6.00%。通过将验证轨迹重写与继承评价模型的策略优化递归耦合，每个保留的阶段都巩固了已发现的行为，并促使智能体逐步从局部的部分修复转向严格的终端验证。

U5ZOcoGLG3w.video_title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models (Oct 2026)

papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.
papers.abstract_zh: 预测世界对某种行为的反应需要的不仅仅是所见之物：机器人必须考虑那些既不可直接观察也不被明确指定的环境因素，从摩擦力和质量等物理属性，到人类定义的各种环境规则。我们引入了用于测试时环境潜变量优化的 T2-Z，它通过一个可学习的环境潜变量来增强机器人世界模型，从而调节对世界的预测。这种紧凑的潜变量无需对环境因素的存在或其具体取值进行监督，即可捕捉底层的环境变化。在训练过程中，T2-Z 在两个阶段之间交替进行：世界模型优化阶段，该阶段固定潜变量并跨环境学习通用的动作条件动态；以及环境潜变量优化阶段，该阶段固定世界模型并优化调节潜变量，使潜变量结构纯粹通过世界预测涌现出来。在测试时，世界模型保持固定，通过一次或多次测试时的交互来优化新初始化的环境潜变量，使模型能够适应先前未见过的环境配置。在 7 种模拟设置和 4 项真实世界机器人任务中，T2-Z 将物体预测误差指标从 15.20 降低至 7.00，并将动作成功率从 33.73% 提高至 72.96%。其涌现出的潜变量捕捉到了跨越不同视觉场景的个体和复合因素的结构化表示。消融实验进一步表明，T2-Z 仅需少至一次测试时的交互轨迹即可高效推断出环境潜变量。

papers.title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further. We implement forgetting in a team of agents with communication and evaluate it on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization and model training. The results show up to 15% improvement compared to parallel agents, and up to 39% compared to a single agent. Our results suggest that, for open-ended discovery, what an agent is allowed to remember matters as much as how much compute it is given.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体进行自动化研究已在多个领域展现出良好的前景。通过迭代改进和评分验证器，LLM智能体能够发现新的思路。目前有多种扩展自动化研究的方法：让单个智能体进行更长时间的迭代、并行运行多个智能体，或者让并行运行的智能体相互交流并在彼此候选方案的基础上进行构建。然而，我们发现随着智能体历史信息的累积，这三种策略最终都会进入平台期。每个智能体都会固守于自身的过往尝试，导致编辑的频率和幅度逐渐降低。超过这一点后，增加计算预算也难以带来实质性提升。在本文中，我们展示了进一步扩展发现能力的关键在于“遗忘”。定期丢弃搜索状态（包括每个智能体的会话和候选历史），并从迄今为止发现的最佳候选方案重新开始，可以打破搜索瓶颈，使同样的预算发挥更大的效用。我们在一个具备通信能力的智能体团队中实现了这种遗忘机制，并在涵盖启发式编程、内核优化和模型训练的四项任务上进行了评估。结果显示，与并行智能体相比，性能提升高达15%，与单个智能体相比提升高达39%。我们的结果表明，对于开放式发现而言，智能体被允许记住什么，其重要性不亚于被赋予了多少计算资源。

OKhpPzY2gZ4.video_title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery

papers.title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代编程智能体正在从根本上重塑人类在计算研究中的角色：它们编写代码、发起计算机模拟实验、分析实验结果，并以不断延长的跨度自主运行。尽管有了这些发展，完全自主的研究智能体仍受限于有限的构思范围和短视的爬山搜索动态。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 The Agentic Scientist，这是一个端到端的分布式流程，旨在让研究人员能够与现代编程智能体并肩开展计算研究。在继承前代系统能力的基础上，我们的系统将研究拆解为任务起草、创意生成、规划、沙盒实验、结果汇总、基线与消融实验构建、事后分析以及论文撰写。至关重要的是，该流程的每一步均由新一代编程智能体驱动，并利用了智能体自我验证机制。整个研究过程由一个元控制器驱动，该控制器负责管理并行研究智能体，并在每个阶段强制执行标准验证。这种设计使得同一编排层能够在具有不同执行环境、编程工具链和评估指标的异构领域中重复使用。我们的系统可在多种自主程度下使用：既可作为科研辅助工具，也可执行端到端的科学调查。在科研辅助模式下，我们利用系统的一个开发版本提交了一篇研究论文，并被 ALIFE 2026 接收。我们进一步将 The Agentic Scientist 完全自主地应用于机器学习领域的开放性问题求解任务，并证明了该系统在不同计算研究领域实现科学发现的能力。我们的消融实验表明，可靠的科学自主性不仅依赖于基础模型的能力，还取决于跨智能体的编排层。

QM69tSXogNw.video_title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views (Oct 2026)

papers.title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/
papers.abstract_zh: 前馈高斯重建技术通过输入图像直接构建三维场景以实现新视角渲染，但从预测几何中学习高斯属性以在大视角变化下进行高质量渲染仍具挑战性。我们分析了高斯属性学习中的局限性，并引入了 InfiniSplat v2，通过架构和训练方面的改进提升了渲染质量。我们的方法通过冻结的几何分支将几何与属性预测解耦，在训练期间利用真值相机位姿对齐预测的高斯球，并采用大角度目标视角监督。在六个数据集上，同一训练模型的前馈输出在位姿条件和无位姿设置下，均在评估方法中达到了最优的平均 LPIPS 和 DISTS 指标。在位姿条件设置下，与最强的评估基线相比，平均 LPIPS 和 DISTS 分别降低了 25.8% 和 32.9%。我们进一步发现，仅利用图像重建监督学习到的不透明度能够抑制几何不一致的点。项目页面：https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

OdMxRqs26C0.video_title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat (Oct 2026)

papers.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we present CyberArena, a dynamic, symmetric adversarial benchmark built around multi-round attack-and-defense combat. In isolated sandboxes, two agents compete under identical rules, acting concurrently as both attackers and defenders over continuously changing services. This converts static targets into evolving, semi-open challenges, directly testing an agent's speed and precision in discovering, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. To sustain the benchmark's longevity, an automated agentic pipeline continuously generates, reviews, and validates new environments. Furthermore, because pairwise contests are notoriously hard to quantify, we introduce a dynamical model that maps match dynamics into unified, multidimensional scores across offensive, defensive, and domain-specific capabilities. Evaluating 12 frontier LLM agents across 40 challenges in 466 matches, CyberArena separates model capabilities where single-agent baselines hit a ceiling. The trajectories read like a fight rather than an exam: defenders patch one hole and miss the next and certify repairs on stale evidence, while capable agents think a move ahead, planting backdoors for later rounds and, in one case, writing their own packet sniffer to watch the opponent. Beyond a benchmark, CyberArena serves as an adaptable, scalable experimental platform for future research on cybersecurity agents.
papers.abstract_zh: AI智能体在现实世界中展现出日益强大的攻防网络安全能力。当前的基准测试大多是在孤立环境下对静态目标进行评估。然而，真实的网络行动是动态且相互耦合的：随着攻击者和防御者实时适应对方，安全态势会不断发生变化。静态基准测试很快就会饱和，且无法评估智能体在实时压力下同时进行攻防的能力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CyberArena，这是一个围绕多轮攻防对抗构建的动态、对称式对抗基准。在隔离的沙箱中，两个智能体在相同的规则下展开竞争，在不断变化的业务环境中同时充当攻击者和防御者。这使得静态目标转化为演进的、半开放的挑战，直接测试了智能体在发现、利用和修复漏洞时的速度与精度。为了维持基准测试的生命力，一个自动化的智能体流水线会持续生成、审查和验证新的环境。此外，由于成对竞赛的量化难度较高，我们引入了一个动力学模型，将比赛动态映射为涵盖攻击、防御和领域特定能力的统一多维分数。通过对466场比赛中40个挑战的12个前沿LLM智能体进行评估，CyberArena区分出了单智能体基准测试已达到上限的模型能力。比赛轨迹读起来更像是实战而非考试：防御者修补了一个漏洞却忽略了下一个，并基于过时的证据证明修复有效；而强能力的智能体会提前布局，为后续轮次埋下后门，甚至在某个案例中编写了自己的数据包嗅探器来监视对手。CyberArena不仅是一个基准测试，还为未来网络安全智能体的研究提供了一个可适应、可扩展的实验平台。

Kr9LxnwPulw.video_title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.
papers.abstract_zh: 长篇智能体视频生成必须将剧本转化为在非连续请求中保持空间和时间一致性的镜头。在镜头之间传递提示词或近期帧无法提供用于重访场景的共享空间框架，也无法提供用于重现早期事件的时间索引记录。我们提出了“任意时间，任意空间”（Any Time, Any Space, ATAS），它将剧本编译为具有明确位置、摄像机和事件时间参考的镜头请求。在生成之前，它会从包含已注册静态几何的场景记忆以及按场景、事件和时间索引的动态观测事件记忆中检索相关证据。生成后，ATAS 会对片段进行重建和注册。它仅在审查和状态检查接受观测结果时才更新记忆，而视频交付则独立于记忆录入。在四个视频生成器上，ATAS 提升了所有报告的跨镜头一致性指标，并为每个主干模型取得了最高的综合基准评分。它在目标图像空间重访方面也优于对比的智能体和 3D 引导方法，在三个事件重现标准中领先，并在所有六项人类评价指标中获得最高分。视频结果和代码可在我们的项目页面获取：https://lhmd.top/atas/。

bTb5be8QMU0.video_title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong \textbf{design intelligence}: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Scene-Designer}, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences. We construct two datasets: \textbf{Scene-OTA-35K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Action supervision for learning scene design and efficient error correction, and \textbf{Scene-OTC-15K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Critic supervision for learning scene quality critique across physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence. Based on these experiences, we propose \textbf{Scene-GRPO}, a Critic-guided GRPO framework that improves design decisions and reduces unnecessary trial-and-error corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence, while the learned Scene-Critic significantly outperforms general-purpose models in scene critique. Moreover, test-time Critic guidance further improves scene generation, showing that the Critic can provide useful guidance beyond training. Additional analysis suggests a trend of mutual enhancement between scene design and critique abilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 从自然语言生成完整、连贯且可用的 3D 室内场景需要强大的设计智能（design intelligence）：即设计高质量场景并对其质量进行评估的能力。然而，现有方法要么依赖于缺乏特定领域设计经验的通用模型，要么从静态场景中学习。在这项工作中，我们引入了 Scene-Designer，这是一个通过互补的设计和评估经验来学习设计智能的智能体框架。我们构建了两个数据集：Scene-OTA-35K，为学习场景设计和高效纠错提供“观察-思考-行动”（Observation--Thought--Action）监督；Scene-OTC-15K，为学习物理有效性、功能正确性和布局连贯性方面的场景质量评估提供“观察-思考-评价”（Observation--Thought--Critic）监督。基于这些经验，我们提出了 Scene-GRPO，这是一种由评论者引导的 GRPO 框架，旨在改进设计决策并减少不必要的试错修正。大量实验表明，Scene-Designer 在物理有效性、功能正确性和布局连贯性方面表现卓越，且所学的 Scene-Critic 在场景评估方面显著优于通用模型。此外，测试时的评论者引导进一步提升了场景生成效果，表明该评论者可以在训练之外提供有益的指导。进一步分析表明，场景设计与评估能力之间存在相互促进的趋势。

r9MJRQNJ2ys.video_title: EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence (Oct 2026)

papers.title: EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Coding agents can construct executable programs and revise them through feedback, offering a foundation for embodied control without target-task fine-tuning. Through a programmatic robot interface, the agent observes the scene, executes control programs, and adapts them to the resulting physical state, serving as the closed-loop policy. However, this within-episode adaptation does not automatically preserve experience across scenes. Our trajectory analysis shows that agents spend interaction and inference budgets establishing effective operations and identifying their preconditions, while fresh agents cannot reuse these discoveries. This motivates EmbodiedEvo, a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons. Experience is acquired on one Playground scene per task, then frozen for independent agents in unseen scenes, without updating model weights. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 编码智能体能够构建可执行程序并通过反馈对其进行修订，这为无需目标任务微调的具身控制奠定了基础。通过编程机器人接口，智能体可以观察场景、执行控制程序，并根据产生的物理状态进行自适应，从而充当闭环策略。然而，这种单剧集内的适应并不能自动在不同场景间保留经验。我们的轨迹分析表明，智能体需要消耗交互和推理预算来建立有效的操作并识别其前提条件，而新的智能体无法重用这些发现。这促使我们提出了 EmbodiedEvo，这是一个能够将物理反馈提炼为可重用的代码技能（Skills）和诊断经验（Lessons）的自进化编码智能体。经验在每个任务的一个训练场景中获取，然后冻结并提供给未见场景中的独立智能体使用，且无需更新模型权重。在 RoboDojo-Sim 上，EmbodiedEvo 的平均得分为 44.48，成功率为 37.82%，超过了所有官方验证的结果。配对测试显示，该方法在依赖记忆的任务中收益最大，并成功重用了协同程序，尽管精细接触控制仍然具有挑战性。来自更强模型的经验也能提升较弱执行者的表现：Astra 的经验使 Sol 和 Luna 的成功率分别提高了 8.86 和 5.50 个百分点。与原始交互历史相比，技能（Skills）和经验（Lessons）在实现相当任务性能的同时，降低了 53.0% 的执行成本。

5nSiZXa4dSc.video_title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries

papers.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 在长文档语境下进行推理对大型语言模型（LLMs）而言仍然是一项挑战。标准的检索方法本质上是被动的，在推理时会限制代理处理复杂跨文档推理的能力；而知识图谱等预计算结构往往因为依赖僵化的启发式规则而表现不佳。我们提出，是否可以让代理执行预期性的定向策划：学习在推理前主动重组非结构化语料库，以高效地服务于各种未来的查询。我们基于现代代理框架（如 Claude Code）中的一个关键非对称性进行构建：尽管 LLM 代理擅长导航现有文件系统以解决即时任务，但它们很少被训练去构建可供未来使用的可重用工作空间。为了实现这一能力，我们引入了 Librarian Agents，这是一个构建者代理将原始文档转换为由合成文件和引用链接组成的层级文件系统的框架，从而为后续的回答代理量身定制工作空间。我们将工作空间的构建表述为马尔可夫决策过程，并通过强化学习优化构建者策略，以直接最大化后续回答的准确率。实验表明，Librarian Agents 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上的表现比最强的检索和预计算基线高出 33 个百分点，能够分摊多次查询中的前期构建成本，并在 BRIGHT 数据集上对未见领域实现了零样本泛化，平均准确率提升了 31 个点。

ONxq4vySlww.video_title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning (Oct 2026)

papers.title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体正越来越多地实现后训练的自动化，但在面对完整的训练栈时，它们往往趋向于监督微调（SFT），并将大部分精力用于修订训练数据。现有系统只赋予智能体单一类型的控制权，即从固定池中选择数据行或调用生成器；而人类数据工程师则会对数据进行比例调整、修剪、修复、替换和合成。我们为此类变更设计了一个数据动作空间，旨在探讨自动化系统能否执行全范围操作而非单一操作，以及这需要何种结构。我们首先使用单个智能体运行此循环，发现它仅能实现一种动作，即调整类别比例，且其上下文会因填满执行输出而在搜索中途被丢弃。因此，我们引入了 AutoSFT，这是一个多智能体系统，其中元智能体将执行与分析分离，从多个独立角度收集方案，并在数据池无法覆盖相关能力时调用合成子智能体，同时在每次比较中保持模型、训练器和预算不变。依次添加各个组件均有帮助：执行器使上下文损失减半，分析子智能体将最佳 IFEval 提升了 +6.5，而合成组件额外增加了 +3.4 IFEval 和 +2.9 IFBench。相同的循环可以迁移到代码领域，分析组件使 MBPP+ 指标比毫无改进的单智能体提升了 +3.7。所有结果均来自每一轮从基础模型重新训练的运行，因此每个组件的效果都是可单独归因的。研究结果表明，SFT 数据研究的自动化更多依赖于覆盖多样化的数据动作，而非增强单一动作的能力。

AJ_1zaW3-2g.video_title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft (Oct 2026)

papers.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们将四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体放入一个沙盒化的《我的世界》（Minecraft）生存世界中，并赋予它们一个目标：击败末影龙。每个智能体通过一个名为 Mineflayer 的开源库控制一名玩家，并通过游戏内聊天和共享内存与队友协作。没有人分配角色或编写游戏逻辑。智能体自行规划、编写并调试了每一个程序。研究人员可以通过实时仪表板观察运行过程，并随时暂停或停止，但全程无需介入。从一个随机生成的简单难度世界开始，该团队共编写了 2,783 个程序，最终在 27 小时 14 分钟内击败了末影龙，期间死亡 605 次。据我们所知，这是 AI 智能体首次在不使用预先探测的种子或其他由人类编写的特定游戏工具的情况下，仅依靠标准的 Mineflayer 库端到端自主完成《我的世界》。获胜要求智能体在超过一天的时间里，在数千个相关联的步骤中保持连贯的计划。复杂的现实世界软件工程和企业任务同样需要这种长周期的编码和多智能体协作能力。我们详细描述了设置过程、运行情况、团队策略（分工、分享所学知识、找回彼此的物品）以及该结果的局限性。

1r7z5iVr1bY.video_title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
papers.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习中的自蒸馏方法日益增多。然而，现有的评估通常在不同实验条件下复用已发表的基线分数，缺乏当代方法之间的直接对比，且对训练稳定性和计算成本的关注有限。这些局限性掩盖了报告收益的来源以及各竞争方法的实际优缺点。昂贵的智能体训练过程进一步强调了建立统一比较基准的必要性。为弥补这些差距，我们在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA和WebShop这四个基准测试上，针对三种模型规模，对比了十种代表性方法与GRPO的表现。本研究共包含132次训练运行，总计耗费12,124.4小时的H800 GPU算时，并对预训练骨干网络及所有11种训练方法进行了八个Rollout随机种子的重复评估。除了最终任务性能外，我们还考察了训练进度、稳定性和测得的计算成本。我们的评估得出了三个关键发现。首先，相比于GRPO的增益范围有限，没有方法能在所有设置下持续优于它。其次，强大的最终性能可能会掩盖不稳定的训练过程。第三，额外的训练成本并不总能转化为更好的性能。我们建立了这一基准，旨在支持公平、全面的对比，并引导未来的研究朝着可靠且具成本效益的智能体训练改进方向发展。项目主页：https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/

7Czj3n5vlE4.video_title: Reasoning Models Explained: From Chain of Thought to Hybrid Reasoning Agents

papers.abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们如何构建一个既能超越人类语言进行思考，又能在外部环境中通过语言进行交互的智能体？现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体主要通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理（latent reasoning）虽然提供了一种高效的内部媒介，却缺乏原生的工具访问能力和推理透明度。我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）弥合了这两个方向，在统一的生成过程中动态地在潜在推理和基于文本的交互之间切换。在架构上，轻量级的 HybridLink 实现了文本模式和潜在模式之间的无缝转换，同时智能体的连续工作记忆在多轮对话中保留了无损的混合上下文。这些设计既保留了集成了工具的智能体能力，又使潜在思考过程可以直接被检查。基于此架构，我们进一步开发了专门的混合推理后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过训练骨干模型与 HybridLink 协同工作，稳定了工具集成的混合生成；随后 HybridRL 通过学习何时在潜在空间进行思考以及何时通过文本采取行动，进一步扩展了推理能力。我们在涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理等领域的 11 个基准测试中，对 3 种模型规模的 HybridAgent 进行了评估。与涵盖基于文本和潜在方法的前沿 LLM 智能体及智能体框架相比，HybridAgent 的性能持续提升了 10.4%，同时减少了 35.5%-54.7% 的 token 使用量，推理速度提高了 1.8 倍至 2.6 倍，成本降低了 2.7 倍至 3.7 倍。代码和数据已发布至 https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent。

papers.abstract: Large pre-trained language models perform remarkably well on tasks that can be done "in one pass", such as generating realistic text or synthesizing computer programs. However, they struggle with tasks that require unbounded multi-step computation, such as adding integers or executing programs. Surprisingly, we find that these same models are able to perform complex multi-step computations -- even in the few-shot regime -- when asked to perform the operation "step by step", showing the results of intermediate computations. In particular, we train transformers to perform multi-step computations by asking them to emit intermediate computation steps into a "scratchpad". On a series of increasingly complex tasks ranging from long addition to the execution of arbitrary programs, we show that scratchpads dramatically improve the ability of language models to perform multi-step computations.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型预训练语言模型在“单次通过”即可完成的任务（如生成逼真的文本或编写计算机程序）上表现出色。然而，它们在需要无界多步计算的任务（如整数加法或程序执行）上却显得力不从心。令人惊讶的是，我们发现这些模型在被要求“逐步”执行操作并展示中间计算结果时，即便是在少样本（few-shot）场景下，也能够完成复杂的多步计算。具体而言，我们通过要求 Transformer 模型将中间计算步骤输出到“草稿纸”（scratchpad）中，来训练其执行多步计算。在一系列难度不断递增的任务（从长整数加法到执行任意程序）上，我们证明了草稿纸显著提高了语言模型执行多步计算的能力。

papers.abstract: We explore how generating a chain of thought -- a series of intermediate reasoning steps -- significantly improves the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning. In particular, we show how such reasoning abilities emerge naturally in sufficiently large language models via a simple method called chain of thought prompting, where a few chain of thought demonstrations are provided as exemplars in prompting. Experiments on three large language models show that chain of thought prompting improves performance on a range of arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning tasks. The empirical gains can be striking. For instance, prompting a 540B-parameter language model with just eight chain of thought exemplars achieves state of the art accuracy on the GSM8K benchmark of math word problems, surpassing even finetuned GPT-3 with a verifier.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了生成思维链（即一系列中间推理步骤）如何显著提升大语言模型执行复杂推理的能力。特别是，我们展示了这种推理能力是如何通过一种名为“思维链提示”（chain of thought prompting）的简单方法在大规模语言模型中自然涌现的——即在提示中提供少量思维链示例作为范例。在三个大语言模型上的实验表明，思维链提示提高了模型在算术、常识和符号推理等一系列任务上的表现。实证收益非常显著。例如，通过仅包含八个思维链示例的提示，一个540B参数的语言模型在GSM8K数学应用题基准测试中达到了最先进的准确率，甚至超越了带有验证器的微调版GPT-3。

papers.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) are widely used in many sub-fields of natural language processing (NLP) and generally known as excellent few-shot learners with task-specific exemplars. Notably, chain of thought (CoT) prompting, a recent technique for eliciting complex multi-step reasoning through step-by-step answer examples, achieved the state-of-the-art performances in arithmetics and symbolic reasoning, difficult system-2 tasks that do not follow the standard scaling laws for LLMs. While these successes are often attributed to LLMs' ability for few-shot learning, we show that LLMs are decent zero-shot reasoners by simply adding "Let's think step by step" before each answer. Experimental results demonstrate that our Zero-shot-CoT, using the same single prompt template, significantly outperforms zero-shot LLM performances on diverse benchmark reasoning tasks including arithmetics (MultiArith, GSM8K, AQUA-RAT, SVAMP), symbolic reasoning (Last Letter, Coin Flip), and other logical reasoning tasks (Date Understanding, Tracking Shuffled Objects), without any hand-crafted few-shot examples, e.g. increasing the accuracy on MultiArith from 17.7% to 78.7% and GSM8K from 10.4% to 40.7% with large InstructGPT model (text-davinci-002), as well as similar magnitudes of improvements with another off-the-shelf large model, 540B parameter PaLM. The versatility of this single prompt across very diverse reasoning tasks hints at untapped and understudied fundamental zero-shot capabilities of LLMs, suggesting high-level, multi-task broad cognitive capabilities may be extracted by simple prompting. We hope our work not only serves as the minimal strongest zero-shot baseline for the challenging reasoning benchmarks, but also highlights the importance of carefully exploring and analyzing the enormous zero-shot knowledge hidden inside LLMs before crafting finetuning datasets or few-shot exemplars.
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）被广泛应用于自然语言处理（NLP）的许多子领域，并因其在特定任务示例下的出色少样本学习能力而闻名。值得注意的是，思维链（CoT）提示作为一种通过分步回答示例来激发复杂多步推理的近期技术，在算术和符号推理等困难的系统-2（system-2）任务中实现了最先进的性能，而这些任务并不遵循LLM的标准缩放定律。虽然这些成功通常归功于LLM的少样本学习能力，但我们证明，只需在每个回答前加上“让我们一步步思考”（Let's think step by step），LLM本身就是出色的零样本推理机。实验结果表明，我们的Zero-shot-CoT在使用相同的单一提示模板时，在包括算术（MultiArith、GSM8K、AQUA-RAT、SVAMP）、符号推理（Last Letter、Coin Flip）以及其他逻辑推理任务（Date Understanding、Tracking Shuffled Objects）在内的多种基准推理任务上，显著优于零样本LLM的表现，且无需任何人工设计的少样本示例。例如，在使用大型InstructGPT模型（text-davinci-002）时，MultiArith的准确率从17.7%提高到78.7%，GSM8K从10.4%提高到40.7%；在使用另一个现成的大型模型——540B参数的PaLM时，也获得了类似幅度的提升。这一单一提示在多种不同推理任务中的通用性，暗示了LLM中存在尚未被开发和深入研究的基本零样本能力，表明通过简单的提示即可提取出高级的、多任务的广泛认知能力。我们希望这项工作不仅能作为应对挑战性推理基准的最小化最强零样本基准，还能强调在构建微调数据集或少样本示例之前，仔细探索和分析隐藏在LLM内部的巨大零样本知识的重要性。

papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting combined with pre-trained large language models has achieved encouraging results on complex reasoning tasks. In this paper, we propose a new decoding strategy, self-consistency, to replace the naive greedy decoding used in chain-of-thought prompting. It first samples a diverse set of reasoning paths instead of only taking the greedy one, and then selects the most consistent answer by marginalizing out the sampled reasoning paths. Self-consistency leverages the intuition that a complex reasoning problem typically admits multiple different ways of thinking leading to its unique correct answer. Our extensive empirical evaluation shows that self-consistency boosts the performance of chain-of-thought prompting with a striking margin on a range of popular arithmetic and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, including GSM8K (+17.9%), SVAMP (+11.0%), AQuA (+12.2%), StrategyQA (+6.4%) and ARC-challenge (+3.9%).
papers.abstract_zh: 思维链提示（Chain-of-thought prompting）与预训练大语言模型相结合，在复杂推理任务上取得了令人振奋的成果。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的解码策略——自洽性（self-consistency），以替代思维链提示中常用的朴素贪婪解码。它首先采样出多种不同的推理路径，而不是仅仅采用贪婪路径，然后通过对采样出的推理路径进行边缘化，选出最一致的答案。自洽性利用了一个直觉，即复杂的推理问题通常可以通过多种不同的思维方式得出唯一的正确答案。我们广泛的实证评估表明，自洽性在多个流行的算术和常识推理基准测试中显著提升了思维链提示的性能，包括 GSM8K (+17.9%)、SVAMP (+11.0%)、AQuA (+12.2%)、StrategyQA (+6.4%) 和 ARC-challenge (+3.9%)。

papers.abstract: In recent years, large language models have greatly improved in their ability to perform complex multi-step reasoning. However, even state-of-the-art models still regularly produce logical mistakes. To train more reliable models, we can turn either to outcome supervision, which provides feedback for a final result, or process supervision, which provides feedback for each intermediate reasoning step. Given the importance of training reliable models, and given the high cost of human feedback, it is important to carefully compare the both methods. Recent work has already begun this comparison, but many questions still remain. We conduct our own investigation, finding that process supervision significantly outperforms outcome supervision for training models to solve problems from the challenging MATH dataset. Our process-supervised model solves 78% of problems from a representative subset of the MATH test set. Additionally, we show that active learning significantly improves the efficacy of process supervision. To support related research, we also release PRM800K, the complete dataset of 800,000 step-level human feedback labels used to train our best reward model.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，大型语言模型在执行复杂多步推理的能力方面取得了显著进步。然而，即使是最先进的模型也仍然经常出现逻辑错误。为了训练更可靠的模型，我们可以采用结果监督（提供最终结果的反馈）或过程监督（为每个中间推理步骤提供反馈）。鉴于训练可靠模型的重要性以及人类反馈的高昂成本，仔细比较这两种方法至关重要。近期研究已经开始了这一比较，但仍有许多问题悬而未决。我们开展了相关研究，发现对于训练模型来解决具有挑战性的 MATH 数据集中的问题，过程监督的效果显著优于结果监督。我们的过程监督模型解决了 MATH 测试集代表性子集中 78% 的问题。此外，我们证明了主动学习能显著提高过程监督的有效性。为了支持相关研究，我们还发布了 PRM800K，这是一个包含 80 万个步骤级人类反馈标签的完整数据集，用于训练我们性能最好的奖励模型。

papers.abstract: Language models are increasingly being deployed for general problem solving across a wide range of tasks, but are still confined to token-level, left-to-right decision-making processes during inference. This means they can fall short in tasks that require exploration, strategic lookahead, or where initial decisions play a pivotal role. To surmount these challenges, we introduce a new framework for language model inference, Tree of Thoughts (ToT), which generalizes over the popular Chain of Thought approach to prompting language models, and enables exploration over coherent units of text (thoughts) that serve as intermediate steps toward problem solving. ToT allows LMs to perform deliberate decision making by considering multiple different reasoning paths and self-evaluating choices to decide the next course of action, as well as looking ahead or backtracking when necessary to make global choices. Our experiments show that ToT significantly enhances language models' problem-solving abilities on three novel tasks requiring non-trivial planning or search: Game of 24, Creative Writing, and Mini Crosswords. For instance, in Game of 24, while GPT-4 with chain-of-thought prompting only solved 4% of tasks, our method achieved a success rate of 74%. Code repo with all prompts: https://github.com/princeton-nlp/tree-of-thought-llm.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型正日益被部署用于各类任务的通用问题求解，但在推理过程中仍局限于词元级的从左到右决策过程。这意味着它们在需要探索、战略性前瞻或初始决策至关重要的任务中可能会表现不佳。为了克服这些挑战，我们引入了一种新的语言模型推理框架——思维树（Tree of Thoughts，简称 ToT）。该框架推广了流行的思维链（Chain of Thought）提示方法，能够对作为问题求解中间步骤的连贯文本单元（即“思维”）进行探索。ToT 允许语言模型通过考虑多种不同的推理路径并自我评估选择来决定下一步行动，从而实现深思熟虑的决策，并在必要时进行前瞻或回溯以做出全局性选择。我们的实验表明，在三个需要复杂规划或搜索的新颖任务（24点游戏、创意写作和迷你填字游戏）中，ToT 显著增强了语言模型的问题求解能力。例如，在24点游戏中，使用思维链提示的 GPT-4 仅解决了 4% 的任务，而我们的方法成功率达到了 74%。包含所有提示词的代码库：https://github.com/princeton-nlp/tree-of-thought-llm。

papers.abstract: Generating step-by-step "chain-of-thought" rationales improves language model performance on complex reasoning tasks like mathematics or commonsense question-answering. However, inducing language model rationale generation currently requires either constructing massive rationale datasets or sacrificing accuracy by using only few-shot inference. We propose a technique to iteratively leverage a small number of rationale examples and a large dataset without rationales, to bootstrap the ability to perform successively more complex reasoning. This technique, the "Self-Taught Reasoner" (STaR), relies on a simple loop: generate rationales to answer many questions, prompted with a few rationale examples; if the generated answers are wrong, try again to generate a rationale given the correct answer; fine-tune on all the rationales that ultimately yielded correct answers; repeat. We show that STaR significantly improves performance on multiple datasets compared to a model fine-tuned to directly predict final answers, and performs comparably to fine-tuning a 30$\times$ larger state-of-the-art language model on CommensenseQA. Thus, STaR lets a model improve itself by learning from its own generated reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成“思维链”（chain-of-thought）推理过程能够提升语言模型在数学或常识问答等复杂推理任务上的表现。然而，目前引导语言模型生成推理过程的方法，要么需要构建海量的推理数据集，要么只能通过少样本（few-shot）推理而牺牲准确性。我们提出了一种技术，通过迭代利用少量带有推理过程的示例和大量不带推理过程的数据集，来引导模型逐步提升进行更复杂推理的能力。这项技术被称为“自学推理器”（Self-Taught Reasoner，简称 STaR），它依赖于一个简单的循环：在少量推理示例的提示下，为多个问题生成推理过程来回答；如果生成的答案错误，则在给定正确答案的情况下尝试重新生成推理过程；利用所有最终得出正确答案的推理过程对模型进行微调；然后重复上述过程。研究表明，与直接微调预测最终答案的模型相比，STaR 在多个数据集上显著提升了性能，并在 CommonsenseQA 上达到了与微调比其大 30 倍的最先进语言模型相当的水平。因此，STaR 让模型能够通过学习自身生成的推理过程来实现自我提升。

papers.abstract: The o1 model series is trained with large-scale reinforcement learning to reason using chain of thought. These advanced reasoning capabilities provide new avenues for improving the safety and robustness of our models. In particular, our models can reason about our safety policies in context when responding to potentially unsafe prompts, through deliberative alignment. This leads to state-of-the-art performance on certain benchmarks for risks such as generating illicit advice, choosing stereotyped responses, and succumbing to known jailbreaks. Training models to incorporate a chain of thought before answering has the potential to unlock substantial benefits, while also increasing potential risks that stem from heightened intelligence. Our results underscore the need for building robust alignment methods, extensively stress-testing their efficacy, and maintaining meticulous risk management protocols. This report outlines the safety work carried out for the OpenAI o1 and OpenAI o1-mini models, including safety evaluations, external red teaming, and Preparedness Framework evaluations.
papers.abstract_zh: o1模型系列通过大规模强化学习进行训练，能够利用思维链（chain of thought）进行推理。这些先进的推理能力为提高模型的安全性和鲁棒性提供了新途径。特别是，我们的模型在响应潜在不安全提示时，可以通过审慎对齐（deliberative alignment）在上下文中对我们的安全策略进行推理。这使得模型在生成非法建议、选择刻板印象回应以及屈服于已知越狱攻击等风险的特定基准测试中达到了顶尖水平。训练模型在回答前加入思维链具有释放巨大效益的潜力，同时也增加了因智能水平提升而带来的潜在风险。我们的研究结果强调了构建稳健对齐方法、对其有效性进行广泛压力测试以及维持严密风险管理协议的必要性。本报告概述了针对OpenAI o1和OpenAI o1-mini模型所开展的安全工作，包括安全评估、外部红队测试以及准备框架（Preparedness Framework）评估。

papers.abstract: General reasoning represents a long-standing and formidable challenge in artificial intelligence. Recent breakthroughs, exemplified by large language models (LLMs) and chain-of-thought prompting, have achieved considerable success on foundational reasoning tasks. However, this success is heavily contingent upon extensive human-annotated demonstrations, and models' capabilities are still insufficient for more complex problems. Here we show that the reasoning abilities of LLMs can be incentivized through pure reinforcement learning (RL), obviating the need for human-labeled reasoning trajectories. The proposed RL framework facilitates the emergent development of advanced reasoning patterns, such as self-reflection, verification, and dynamic strategy adaptation. Consequently, the trained model achieves superior performance on verifiable tasks such as mathematics, coding competitions, and STEM fields, surpassing its counterparts trained via conventional supervised learning on human demonstrations. Moreover, the emergent reasoning patterns exhibited by these large-scale models can be systematically harnessed to guide and enhance the reasoning capabilities of smaller models.
papers.abstract_zh: 通用推理是人工智能领域长期存在的一项艰巨挑战。以大型语言模型（LLMs）和思维链提示（chain-of-thought prompting）为例的近期突破，在基础推理任务上已取得了显著成就。然而，这些成功在很大程度上依赖于大量的人工标注演示，且模型在处理更复杂的问题时能力依然不足。在此，我们证明了大型语言模型的推理能力可以通过纯强化学习（RL）来激发，从而无需人工标注的推理轨迹。所提出的强化学习框架促进了高级推理模式的涌现，如自我反思、验证和动态策略调整。因此，训练出的模型在数学、编程竞赛和STEM领域等可验证任务上表现优异，超越了通过传统监督学习和人工演示训练的同类模型。此外，这些大规模模型展现出的涌现推理模式可以被系统性地利用，以引导并增强较小模型的推理能力。

papers.abstract: Test-time scaling is a promising new approach to language modeling that uses extra test-time compute to improve performance. Recently, OpenAI's o1 model showed this capability but did not publicly share its methodology, leading to many replication efforts. We seek the simplest approach to achieve test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance. First, we curate a small dataset s1K of 1,000 questions paired with reasoning traces relying on three criteria we validate through ablations: difficulty, diversity, and quality. Second, we develop budget forcing to control test-time compute by forcefully terminating the model's thinking process or lengthening it by appending "Wait" multiple times to the model's generation when it tries to end. This can lead the model to double-check its answer, often fixing incorrect reasoning steps. After supervised finetuning the Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct language model on s1K and equipping it with budget forcing, our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24). Further, scaling s1-32B with budget forcing allows extrapolating beyond its performance without test-time intervention: from 50% to 57% on AIME24. Our model, data, and code are open-source at https://github.com/simplescaling/s1
papers.abstract_zh: 测试时扩展（Test-time scaling）是一种新兴且前景广阔的语言建模方法，它利用额外的测试时计算来提升模型性能。近期，OpenAI 的 o1 模型展示了这一能力，但并未公开其方法论，促使了许多复现尝试。我们旨在寻求实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简方法。首先，我们策划了一个包含 1,000 个问题及对应推理轨迹的小型数据集 s1K，该数据集基于我们通过消融实验验证的三个准则：难度、多样性和质量。其次，我们开发了“预算强制（budget forcing）”方法，通过强制终止模型的思考过程，或在模型试图结束时多次追加“Wait”来延长其生成，从而控制测试时的计算量。这可以促使模型对答案进行二次检查，通常能修正不正确的推理步骤。在对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 语言模型进行 s1K 数据集的监督微调并配备预算强制机制后，我们的 s1-32B 模型在竞赛数学问题（MATH 和 AIME24）上的表现超过了 o1-preview，最高提升达 27%。此外，通过结合预算强制对 s1-32B 进行扩展，使其性能超越了无测试时干预的基准水平：在 AIME24 上从 50% 提升至 57%。我们的模型、数据和代码已在 https://github.com/simplescaling/s1 开源。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently demonstrated notable success in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly on mathematics and programming tasks. Similar to how traditional RL helps agents explore and learn new strategies, RLVR is believed to enable LLMs to continuously self-improve, thus acquiring novel reasoning abilities beyond those of the corresponding base models. In this study we critically examine the current state of RLVR by systematically probing the reasoning capability boundaries of RLVR-trained LLMs across various model families, RL algorithms, and math, coding, and visual reasoning benchmarks, using pass@k at large k values as the evaluation metric. Surprisingly, we find that the current training setup does not elicit fundamentally new reasoning patterns. While RLVR-trained models outperform their base models at small k (e.g., k = 1), the base models achieve a higher pass@k score when k is large. Coverage and perplexity analyses show that the observed reasoning abilities originate from and are bounded by the base model. Treating the base model as an upper bound, our quantitative analysis shows that six popular RLVR algorithms perform similarly and remain far from optimal in leveraging the potential of the base model. By contrast, we find that distillation can introduce new reasoning patterns from the teacher and genuinely expand the model's reasoning capabilities.
